The Artificer replaces your Worn Vow Fitting. 'A lost appointment is still an appointment.'
The Artificer looks at the gaps. 'A full Hematic Iron set, worn on the body. Then I will fit it.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.artificer_livin: The Artificer gives you the Assumed Limb Fitting. It records seven assumed limbs, adds no fang or hidden strength, and proves the work.
The Artificer smiles without softness. 'Your arsenal is already fitted.'
The Artificer replaces your Assumed Limb Fitting. 'The staff remembers what your pockets do not.'
The Artificer listens to your staff. 'The staff still lacks some of the seven forms.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.artificer_three: The Alchemist gives you the reagent for your recorded armor family. 'Catalog its living examples and I may refine another measure.'
The Artificer gestures to the bowls. 'You already claimed that reagent.'
The Artificer waits. 'Make one forked armor piece first. Then we discuss answers.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.artificer_worn_: The Artificer gives you Hematic Iron Scrap. 'One piece learned. Teach the others.'
The Artificer shuts the little drawer. 'You already took the scrap for that lesson.'
The Artificer shakes their head. 'Complete one Hematic Iron armor upgrade first.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.gives_stained_c: [A stained route is placed where you can take it. The marked church feels less found than remembered.]
hemomancy.dialogue.event.hermit_accept_g: Take the waybill to the outpost. Its Vicar will hear your choice and receive you into the Order, if that is what you wish.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.hermit_archon_w: The Hermit bows deeply. 'All that I know is already written in your blood, Archon.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.hermit_farewell: §7[The Hermit clutches at the hollow in its chest where its heart once beat, the Mortal Display, now claimed. Crimson light spills from the wound as its body begins to unravel.]
hemomancy.dialogue.event.hermit_heart_of: You have my permission. Touch the Mortal Display and receive my heart, then return to me before you leave.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.hermit_passing: §o'The heart was never mine to keep... only to offer. Wake it in the threshold beneath us. When the rite takes you, seek the others at their outpost. They will teach you what I was never meant to teach. I go now where the blood returns to silence.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.lady_clarity_ri: §bThe words settle into your mind like a stone into still water. The Rite of Clarity Ascension. You know what you must do.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.lady_enlightene: §bThe cold clarity of her words settles into you like snow. You are finished with the life that brought you here. Somehow, that is better.
§bShe remains. She was never standing somewhere else. The world is simply quieter now.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.mnemonist_start: The Mnemonist smiles faintly. Your blood already knows that motion.
The Mnemonist releases a crude memory shard. The echo waits for your blood.
The Mnemonist closes their hand around the echo. This lesson is not yours to claim now.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.mnemonist_woven: The Mnemonist indexes the blank vessel. Choose Blood Shot at the Loom: one bulb, 50 blood, and one vivacious enzyme. Keep a Living Staff in hand. The engram will unfurl around the Loom: rest your gaze on the fragment to hear it, then hold the staff on it and sweep its thread along the star's lines into the Loom.
The Mnemonist closes the archive. 'This vessel has already been indexed. Use what it taught you.'
The Mnemonist waits beside an empty desk. 'A book, ink, and three sheets of paper. Memory without an index is only hunger.'
The Mnemonist extends an empty hand. 'First bring the blank memory. The lesson needs a vessel.'
The Mnemonist listens to your pulse and shakes their head. 'Not yet. Finish the red catalogue, then return as Initiate.'
hemomancy.dialogue.event.monolith_corner: §4The Lodestone presses a Monolithic Cornerstone into your hand. It is small, cold, and heavier than it should be.
The Lodestone has already given you its cornerstone. It will not repeat the offering.
The Lodestone remains silent. It answers Archons who have already worked a consecrated Armature.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.qliphoth_commun: §4§oSomething vast, ancient, and patient recognizes you. The silence of the ninth shell settles into your bones.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.reject_help: The Zealot watches you turn away, silver eyes dimming.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.scout_gives_not: §7[The Scout presses a small, water-stained journal into your hands. Her grip loosens almost immediately.]
hemomancy.dialogue.event.vein_mason_firs: The Vein-Mason gives you a Scar Pattern and the materials to carve it.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.vein_mason_know: The Vein-Mason has already given you your first pattern.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.vein_mason_rewa: The Vein-Mason gives you a second pattern, a blank scar, its catalyst, and fresh Motif Paper.
The Vein-Mason has already given you the continuation kit.
The Vein-Mason waits for you to commit the first loadout.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.vicar_assignmen: The Vicar places the Assignment Ledger in your keeping. Formal work begins here. Lost copies can be reissued.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.vicar_blood_sho: §4Your eyes ache as the blood-script begins arranging itself into meaning.
§8The blood-script is already open to you.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.artificer_conse: The Artificer gives you an Armature Consecration Kit.
The Artificer has already issued your kit. A canceled rite returns its offerings, and you now know how to craft another.
The Artificer holds the kit back until you have worked the Armature yourself and reached the fifth Degree with your blood awake.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.vicar_first_blo: The promotion could not be completed. Ask the Vicar again.
The Vicar grants the Second Degree and issues the Order's first bloodcraft kit, if you have not already received it.
The Order has already recognized your First Bloodcraft service.
The Vicar is waiting for all four first bloodcraft proofs: absorption, formation, Venous Stone, and one structure craft.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.vicar_gives_scr: §7[The Vicar reaches into the folds of their vestments and produces a small, weathered fragment of parchment. They press it into your hands without ceremony.]
hemomancy.dialogue.event.vicar_hermit_ro: The Vicar taps the ledger once. 'You already carry the proper record. Use it.'
The Vicar gives you a Harbinger Assignment Ledger.
The Vicar records the wild remnant as a side road and gives you ash for the journey.
The Vicar waits for proof from a wild remnant, not a familiar stone.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.vicar_masons_re: The route to Masons Respite is already yours.
The Vicar gives you a scar-scribed route to Masons Respite.
The Vicar will not speak of the Vein-Mason before the Fourth Degree.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.whisper_truth_a: §4A deep, fungal awareness settles into your bones. You cannot unhear what has been spoken.
hemomancy.dialogue.guardian.option.ask_a: I have a question about something I found...
hemomancy.dialogue.guardian.option.task_: I will ring the Pale Watch.
I will plate the quiet watch.
hemomancy.dialogue.hermit.option.accept_: I understand. Show me the way.
hemomancy.dialogue.hermit.option.how_do_: How do I begin the path of hemomancy?
How do scars reshape the mind?
hemomancy.dialogue.hermit.option.what_he: What is this heart you speak of?
hemomancy.dialogue.hermit.option.who_are: Who are you? Why are you here?
hemomancy.dialogue.mnemonist.option.ask_: What can you tell me about this?
Tell me about the Somatic Loom.
How should I choose which memories to keep ready?
How do I save a memory loadout?
Tell me about the Mnemonic Reliquary.
How do active manipulation slots work?
hemomancy.dialogue.mnemonist.option.choo: Can you teach me an early echo?
hemomancy.dialogue.mnemonist.option.take: Give me a waybill to their pavilion.
hemomancy.dialogue.mnemonist.option.turn: I brought the blank vessel and archive materials.
hemomancy.dialogue.mnemonist.option.wove: How do I prepare a blank memory?
hemomancy.dialogue.monolith.option.ancho: What does the Armature still lack?
hemomancy.dialogue.option.ask_about_item: I have a question about something I found...
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.alchemist.acc: I accept. My expertise is now bound to your pool. Use it wisely. Every drop I contribute carries the weight of the Order's craft.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.alchemist.con: Pledge my blood? An unusual request. But the Lodge teaches us that shared knowledge flows best through shared veins.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.already_membe: This Harbinger has already pledged their blood to your cause.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.expel.success: %s has been released from your bloodline covenant.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.mnemonist.acc: Call it covenant. One lesson carried by more than one body.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.mnemonist.con: A bloodline is also a memory. If you bind me into yours, my pulse will answer when your reserve thins.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.no_bloodline: You must first found a bloodline through the Degree-5 Bloodline Founding rite before you can recruit others.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.not_leader: Only the bloodline progenitor may dismiss pledged members.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.not_member: This Harbinger is not bound to your bloodline.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.option.confir: You are accepted into the bloodline.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.option.pledge: Pledge your blood to my cause.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.option.releas: Our pact is ended. Withdraw from my bloodline.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.outpost_alrea: This outpost has already given one voice to your bloodline. Let the rest carry the cause outward.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.success: %s has pledged their blood to your bloodline. Their vitality strengthens the shared pool. If they die, that strength is lost and their recruitment slot opens again.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.type_already_: A Harbinger of this calling has already pledged to your bloodline.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.vicar.accept: Very well. My blood is your blood. The Covenant strengthens when its servants unite under a single will.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.vicar.conside: You ask me to bind my blood to yours? An Illuminatus of the Crimson Lodge commands respect... and obedience.
hemomancy.dialogue.scout.option.go_in_pe: §7[You take the notes and step away.]
hemomancy.dialogue.scout.option.take_not: I will take them. They will be used.
I will take them. Your work will not be wasted.

hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.about_th: Have you heard of any path beyond the seven degrees?

I have a question about something I found...
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.claim_fi: I have completed the first bloodcraft lessons.
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.consecra: Who prepares the Armature for consecration?
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.first_bl: What followed my First Bloodcraft assignment?
How do I finish my first bloodcraft lessons?
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.open_blo: Open my eyes to the blood-script.
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.purifyin: I know what I am doing.

hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.tell_me_: Tell me about the Sanguine Brotherhood.
Tell me about the Hematic Covenant.

hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.what_do_: What do you make of what I have become?

hemomancy.dialogue.voyager.option.record: I noticed how the reef answered the current.

hemomancy.drudge.memory_unsupported: This memory cannot be installed in a Drudge.
hemomancy.guardian.ambient.line1: §7[The Guardian holds still. Their gaze meets yours, brief and measured.]§r Stand your ground. Keep your hands clean.
hemomancy.guardian.item_hint: Choose the object from your pack. I will tell you whether it belongs in the field.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.absoluti: Every pledged Unstained receives an Absolution Dagger at Clarity Ascension. It is last resort, mercy, and self-defence.
Its hemolytic treatment is inherent. A temporary coating would be wasted on it.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.bow.line: A bow keeps blood at distance. That alone makes it useful.
Use the ammunition you possess. Pale-silver arrows help only after they have been made.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.crossbow: A crossbow buys distance with force and time with a slow reload.
Choose the shot before the line closes.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.golden_a: A golden apple. A concentrated restoration compound from outside our practice. It is effective, and I have used one when standard field medicine was exhausted.
Keep proper Unstained field medicine for treatment and blood-corruption exposure. A golden apple buys time when serious damage leaves you no other option.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.hemolyti: Hemolytic plating is sheet material treated with solution and cured into a stable form. It disrupts blood-magic on contact, which makes a useful lining for gear worn in afflicted areas.
The plating holds the lytic compound indefinitely. Raw solution degrades on fabric or ordinary metal. The plated form keeps the effect, and advanced Guardian equipment requires it.
Hemolytic solution breaks blood-matrix corruption. Carry it for treatment and for equipment whose live recipe supports application.
The Absolution Dagger carries its own permanent treatment.
Hemolytic solution. Use it as the Church instructs, not as a universal varnish for every weapon in the rack.
Know the equipment before you spend the dose.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.iron_che: Plain iron. It stops ordinary blows and makes no claim against infection.
Maintain it until proper Unstained armour is ready.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.iron_swo: A blade works, but arm's-length fighting around infectious blood is dangerous.
Keep distance, keep discipline, and use a sanctioned treatment where the weapon actually accepts one.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.lethean_: Lethean brew, the distilled concentrate of lethean dew. It is stronger than raw dew and belongs in deeper Altar rites. In the field, it treats blood exposure with greater force.
Handle it carefully. Lethean brew disrupts blood matrices more forcefully than the dew. Measured doses treat exposure. A Guardian carrying it is ready for sustained operations.
Lethean Dew is prepared through the Church's current condenser and Ghost Pipe work, not simply gathered because dawn looked holy.
Carry it sealed. Field medicine begins with not contaminating the medicine.
The Lethean Poppy grows where purification has taken hold. The water has gone still, and the blood-taint has receded. Finding poppies means Our Lady has already touched the place.
Those areas are typically lower-risk for blood-afflicted encounters. Mark them. The Zealots upstream need to know where the cleansed ground is expanding.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.minecraf: A serviceable field implement. Keep it clean, keep your reach, and open blood only with cause.
Against active infection, distance and restraint matter more than ornament.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.pale_dis: Pale distillate is refined from Lethean Poppies. Zealots use it in advanced Altar work. In the field, it is the strongest lytic material available. Use it sparingly.
You will rarely need this directly in combat. If you support Zealot operations, learn how it is made upstream. Carry it when requested. Leave it for ritual work otherwise.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.pale_sil: A Pale Silver Bell marks warning, retreat, and cleared ground.
Ring once with purpose. Panic makes poor signals.
Pale Silver is refined from Consecrated Copper. There is no ore to mine and no iron shortcut.
Guard it. Every ingot records completed ritual work.
Field tool. Pale silver breaks through blood-hardened stone without triggering secondary affliction. Useful in reclamation work.
Not a weapon by design. Capable of functioning as one in an emergency. Pale silver disrupts blood-affliction on contact regardless of form.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.pallid_i: A consecrated copy of the river Icon. It gives the line a direction when fear makes every road look alike.
Carry it as witness, not as a substitute for vigilance.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.shield.l: A shield stops force. This one carries no special anti-blood promise.
Keep it between the wound and your face.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.silthmer: The Silthmere Glaive is sanctioned for its reach. The edge matters less than keeping infectious blood beyond the hands.
Hold the line and give the wound room.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.sporitic: Harbinger work. Fungal support smoke, paid for in blood.
Keep it out of a clean line. The fumes belong to the fungus, not to us.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.liber_im: The Liber records the path every Guardian is sworn to understand, and many of us have walked ourselves.
Read its First Steps before you approach the Podium.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.unknown: That falls outside my work. Ask another hand.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.unstaine: Unstained armour is fieldwear for those who stand close to active corruption.
Keep every seal sound. Clean equipment is a discipline, not a colour.
Unstained guardwork, built for a clean defensive line.
Use the protection the item grants. Let it do that job.
hemomancy.guardian.item_inquiry.warhamme: A hammer keeps a wound closed. That is why it reaches our hands first.
Strike to stop. Save what you came to contain.
hemomancy.hematic_salvage.first_drop: The torn iron comes away red, as if it remembered a deeper ore.
hemomancy.hermit.adept.hint: Your manipulation slots grow with your degree. Master the skill tree to unlock more. The Rite of the Crimson Lodge beckons, but first, consider the Cerebral Scarring Station. Scars are the key to shaping what lies within.
hemomancy.hermit.adept.line2: Adept of the Sanguine Brotherhood. Few reach this depth without losing themselves. You carry something rare: a mind sharp enough to carve new pathways.
hemomancy.hermit.adept.scar_crafting: Seek the Cerebral Scarring Station. There, with a knapper in hand and a blank scar before you, carve the sacred patterns. Each scar requires specific materials aligned to the tendency it embodies. The process cuts through the barriers in your mind as surely as it cuts stone. Wear the scar and feel the new pathways awaken.
hemomancy.hermit.adept.scar_intro: You have earned the right to know of Scars. They are more than symbols scratched into stone. Each scar maps new venous and nervous pathways across the landscape of your mind.
hemomancy.hermit.adept.scar_lore: When you inscribe a scar, you open yourself and create new channels for blood and thought to flow. Each line is a vein, and each curve is a nerve. The pattern reshapes your inner architecture, allowing ideas and tendencies that were once sealed away to surface and take root.
hemomancy.hermit.apotheos.final_words: §oWhat remains for me? The same as always: the vigil. But its meaning has changed. I kept this threshold so that one day, someone might go far enough to make my duty feel small. §4You have done that. I am grateful.
hemomancy.hermit.apotheos.line1: §4[The Hermit has no words. They press both hands over the place where their heart once was and incline their head so low it is almost a fall.]
hemomancy.hermit.apotheos.line2: §oYou have gone further than any keeper of this threshold was ever told to expect. The instructions they gave me ended at the seventh degree. I stand before you with empty hands and a full heart, Apotheos. §4Go well.
hemomancy.hermit.archon.line2: Archon of the Hematic Order. You are the blood incarnate. I am but a keeper of dust and memory. Command me, and I shall serve.
hemomancy.hermit.illuminatus.hint: The Bloodline Covenant is the next frontier. Seek allies who share your blood. The Bloodline system allows shared pools and cooperative healing. The Rite of the Bloodline Covenant awaits.
hemomancy.hermit.illuminatus.line1: Illuminatus of the Crimson Lodge. You have seen what lies behind the veil. The ancient knowledge is yours to command.
hemomancy.hermit.initiate.hint: The Somatic Loom awaits your mastery. There you may weave memories of blood into new manipulations. Seek the Rite of the Sanguine Brotherhood to prove yourself an Adept.
hemomancy.hermit.initiate.line1: Initiate of the Incarnadine Fane. You walk deeper into the mysteries. The blood sings louder in your presence.
hemomancy.hermit.manip_lore: Blood manipulations are the voice of your hemomancy. Each one shapes the crimson tide within you. Learn them, equip them at a Mnemonic Reliquary, and let your blood speak.
hemomancy.hermit.neophyte.hint: Return to the Vicar. Absorb 500 ml, fill a cauldron with projected blood and take out the Sanguine Formation it condenses, project Venous Stone from ordinary stone, then craft either a Liber Sanguinium or Hematic Iron Block with a blood formation.
hemomancy.hermit.neophyte.line2: Neophyte. You have taken the first step through the Crimson Veil. The blood recognizes you now.
hemomancy.hermit.no_blood.duty.line1: I was placed here by the Archons of old for one purpose: stand vigil until a worthy soul arrived. Every Harbinger Hermit before me kept the same oath, guarding the heart and guiding the newcomer.
hemomancy.hermit.no_blood.duty.line2: If you accept my blessing, this temple's heart will answer you and no other. Choose the path first, then claim it and I will show you how to wake it. §oMourn if you must. The blood needs a new vessel, and old keepers have to end.
hemomancy.hermit.no_blood.heart_lore: The Mortal Display bears my living heart. With my permission, its touch will attach the Charm of Vascularium and awaken your blood. Then seek the Vicar. Until your formal initiation, the charm can still be removed.
hemomancy.hermit.no_blood.line1: §7[A hooded figure stirs from the shadows, its crimson eyes settling upon you with ancient patience]
hemomancy.hermit.no_blood.line2: At last... another wanderer finds these halls. I am the Harbinger Hermit, the last keeper of this threshold. My life's sole duty has been welcoming those who walk the path of blood.
hemomancy.hermit.no_blood.line3: This heart before you, §cthe Mortal Display§r, is mine. I can bless you to claim it, but neither blessing nor touch will initiate you. You choose when to wake the temple's Cardinal Focus.
hemomancy.hermit.sanctified.hint: Only one rite remains: the Rite of the Hematic Order. To become Archon is to become the blood itself. Prepare yourself. The final trial spares no one.
hemomancy.hermit.sanctified.line1: Sanctified one. The Bloodline Covenant has blessed you. You stand among the highest of our Order.
hemomancy.hermit.temple_lore: These temples were raised by the first Archons, long before the Order fractured. The small threshold in this floor is a mercy: a first rite already prepared for someone who cannot yet project blood or command a Living Staff.
hemomancy.hermit.tendency_lore: Every manipulation carries a primary tendency, and many carry a secondary current beneath it. As you master them, your blood will lean toward both the path you choose and the echoes braided through it. Embrace this; it is the nature of hemomancy.
hemomancy.hermit.uninitiated.farewell.li: §7[The Hermit's form flickers, its body growing translucent as crimson light bleeds from its chest]
It is done. My heart is yours, and my duty is fulfilled. Walk the path of blood without fear. The Covenant will guide you beyond what I was meant to teach. §4Farewell, young Harbinger.
hemomancy.hermit.uninitiated.guidance: The charm carries my heart now. Follow the waybill to a Harbinger outpost and speak with its Vicar. You have received the blood, but membership in the Order must still be your choice.
hemomancy.hermit.uninitiated.line1: §7[The Hermit's eyes widen, a trembling smile crossing its gaunt face]
hemomancy.hermit.uninitiated.line2: You have claimed my heart. The Charm of Vascularium carries its pulse within you.
hemomancy.hermit.uninitiated.line3: My vigil is nearly complete. Let me tell you where the road leads before I depart.
hemomancy.hermit.votary.hint: The Alchemist must see your first separation and your first ordinary Alembic distillation. After both, ask for Concentrated Blood, inject it, and rest.
hemomancy.hermit.votary.line2: Votary of the Hematic Covenant. You have proven your dedication. The blood flows deeper now.
hemomancy.item.sanguine_conduit.place_lo: Your blood has not yet earned the authority to claim this ground.
A pulsing instrument of the Order. Its deeper purpose awaits higher initiation.
Drive it into the ground as an oath-post for your covenant.
Right-click a surface to plant. Breaking it recovers the conduit.
hemomancy.jei.craft.steps.self: Lay its floor and any structure it needs, seat the medium, light the braziers, plant the Living Staff and carry the rite to its ascension.
hemomancy.jei.craft.steps.world: Lay its floor and any structure it needs, seat the medium, light the braziers, plant the Living Staff and hold the rite until the world answers.
hemomancy.jei.craft.steps.bond: Lay its floor and any structure it needs, seat the medium, light the braziers, plant the Living Staff and keep the bond until it is sealed.

hemomancy.jei.craft.tip.floor: Floor block; lay around the Cardinal Focus

hemomancy.jei.enzyme_fruiting.blood.tip: Drawn from the Lantern over the whole fruiting.
hemomancy.jei.incubator.polyp.tip: Seat the polyp in the centre socket.
hemomancy.jei.incubator.blood.tip: Drawn from the incubator while the polyp gestates.
hemomancy.jei.incubator.time.tip: Gestation pauses whenever the incubator runs dry.
Rest the graft in an Iron Brazier
hemomancy.jei.living_weapon_graft.steps: Place the graft in a lit Iron Brazier, then hold Blood Absorption on it with the Living Staff.
hemomancy.jei.morphic_nectar.hint.tip: Drop the item into a Morphic Nectar pool and let it soak.
hemomancy.jei.white_humor_purification.h: Drop the item into White Humor; each source purifies up to 32 items.
hemomancy.jei.memory_weaving.blood.toolt: Drawn from the loom's own reservoir as the weave begins.
hemomancy.jei.memory_weaving.fragments.t: Each enzyme is one engram fragment the weaver must thread home.
hemomancy.jei.memory_weaving.stage.0.des: Any Somatic Loom can weave this.
hemomancy.jei.memory_weaving.stage.1.des: Needs a Ganglionic Loom: a harness set at the Rite of the Ganglionic Weave.
hemomancy.jei.memory_weaving.stage.2.des: Needs a Cortical Loom: a crown set at the Rite of the Cortical Weave.
hemomancy.lady.absolved.v0.follow: §b§oAbsolution is not the end of the path. It is only the end of the first descent. Beyond lies clarity, a second gift if you would have it.
hemomancy.lady.absolved.v0.line1: §b§oYou shine more clearly now. The old stain fades faster than it grew.
hemomancy.lady.absolved.v0.line2: §b§oI have watched others walk this path. Most falter at this stage. The blood is quieter now, almost pleasant in its absence. Quiet still carries danger.
hemomancy.lady.absolved.v1.line1: §b§oThe blood-saints will call you a traitor. Let them. You betrayed corruption, which is the first honest act of your life.
hemomancy.lady.absolved.v1.line2: §b§oYour hands are almost clean. Finish the work.
hemomancy.lady.absolved.v2.line1: §b§o[The voice is clearer than ever before, still cold, but no longer distant.]
hemomancy.lady.absolved.v2.reveal1: §b§oI am ancient. I was old when the first blood-temple was raised, and I will remain when the last one crumbles. I am what the blood-cult forgot to bury.
hemomancy.lady.absolved.v2.reveal2: §b§oDo not seek to understand me yet. Purify yourself completely. Then we will speak properly.
hemomancy.lady.cleansing.v0.line1: §b§oYou are doing well, child. I can feel the corruption thinning.
hemomancy.lady.cleansing.v0.line2: §b§oThe blood loosens its hold slowly, but it does loosen. Continue.
hemomancy.lady.cleansing.v0.reveal: §b§oI am what remains when the river has finished washing a stone clean. I have many names. The Unstained call me Our Lady.
hemomancy.lady.cleansing.v1.line1: §b§oThe blood's quiet seduction feels harmless. Even still water will drown you, given time.
hemomancy.lady.cleansing.v1.line2: §b§oCleanness of body begins with cleanness of intent. Choose restraint because you choose to.
hemomancy.lady.cleansing.v2.follow: §b§oThe Unstained who came before you each asked why they were chosen. I did not choose you. You chose yourself, the moment you turned away from the red tide.
hemomancy.lady.cleansing.v2.line1: §b§o[A voice drifts through the stillness, calm, unhurried, like water finding its level.]
hemomancy.lady.discerning.v0.follow: §b§oUse the Verdigris Aura when you face blood-touched enemies. Clarity is a weapon as much as a gift.
hemomancy.lady.discerning.v0.line1: §b§oThere. You can see the shape beneath the surface now.
hemomancy.lady.discerning.v0.line2: §b§oClarity is precision. The world stays cruel when you see it clearly, but now you can name the cruelty.
hemomancy.lady.discerning.v1.line1: §b§oYou have begun to sense the blood-work in others. This will serve you. Few things are more dangerous than a hemomancer unaware of being watched.
hemomancy.lady.discerning.v2.line1: §b§o[A gentle presence settles over your shoulders, patient, cold, and oddly comforting.]
hemomancy.lady.discerning.v2.line2: §b§oContinue as you have been. Restraint deepens the clarity, and honest deeds widen the sight.
hemomancy.lady.discerning.v2.reveal: §b§oI am older than the hemomancy you left behind. I was here when the first blood was spilled, and I have been watching ever since. Patience is easy when you have eternity.
hemomancy.lady.enlightened.v0.line2: §b§oAll of it. The blood-cult's roots. The fungal network beneath it. The thing that predates both of them, that both of them were built on top of, and that both of them will eventually dissolve back into.
hemomancy.lady.enlightened.v0.truth1: §b§oI am the stillness at the bottom of all things. Not death. Stillness. The silence before the first sound. The water before the first ripple.
hemomancy.lady.enlightened.v0.truth2: §b§oYou have walked through the blood and the fungus and emerged on the other side. There is no further shore. There is only this: standing here, knowing, with nothing left to fear from either of them.
hemomancy.lady.enlightened.v1.line1: §b§oThe Harbingers call what you have done a betrayal. The fungal network calls it pruning. Both are correct, in their way.
hemomancy.lady.enlightened.v1.line2: §b§oYou stepped outside the story written for you. Few things in any world are rarer. I am glad you did.
hemomancy.lady.enlightened.v2.line1: §b§o[She simply exists: present, cold, complete, ancient beyond measure, and entirely satisfied.]
hemomancy.lady.enlightened.v2.truth1: §b§oI will tell you the last truth now, because you have earned it: I am not here to save you. I never was.
hemomancy.lady.enlightened.v2.truth2: §b§oI am here because this is where the water rests when the flood is over. You came to me when you were done drowning. That is enough. That has always been enough.
hemomancy.lady.purified.v0.line2: §b§oThe crimson tide is gone from you entirely. You stand on the far shore of the blood-sea, beyond its reach.
hemomancy.lady.purified.v0.rite1: §b§oThere is more, if you want it. A second sight, a deeper knowing. The Unstained call it Clarity.
hemomancy.lady.purified.v0.rite2: §b§oPurity is complete. Close the final vein first. Only after your mortal baseline is restored may you prepare the pledge.
hemomancy.lady.purified.v1.line1: §b§oYou are fully purified, child. I am... pleased. It has been some time since I watched someone walk this road to its end.
hemomancy.lady.purified.v1.line2: §b§oRest, if you need it. Then perform Closed Vein, offer Consecrated Copper at the Podium, and approach Clarity Ascension as a pledge.
hemomancy.lady.purified.v2.line1: §b§o[The voice is no longer a whisper. It speaks from everywhere and nowhere, with the tone of someone who has been waiting a very long time.]
hemomancy.lady.purified.v2.rite1: §b§oFirst close the old current with Closed Vein. Then offer Consecrated Copper at the Podium and arrange the Rite of Clarity Ascension. That rite is the Church's pledge.
hemomancy.lady.resolute.v0.follow1: §b§oI will not lie to you. The final clarity changes things. Some who reach it have called me something other than a patron.
hemomancy.lady.resolute.v0.follow2: §b§oContinue anyway. The truth, however cold, is better than the warmth of a comfortable lie.
hemomancy.lady.resolute.v0.line1: §b§oYou are three-quarters of the way to the end of this road. Most turn back here, though not because they falter.
hemomancy.lady.resolute.v0.line2: §b§oThey turn back after seeing the end of the path. It asks for more than they hoped to give.
hemomancy.lady.resolute.v1.line1: §b§oYou have become very hard to deceive. Congratulations. The Harbingers would give a great deal to have that ability in their service.
hemomancy.lady.resolute.v1.line2: §b§oThe blood-cult avoids clarity. A clear-eyed Archon would see the Order exactly as it is, and the Order would not survive that sight.
hemomancy.lady.resolute.v2.line1: §b§o[The voice is still and precise as a knife on glass.]
hemomancy.lady.resolute.v2.reveal1: §b§oYou will ask me soon what I am, and I will tell you the truth. I am not what the Unstained believe me to be.
hemomancy.lady.resolute.v2.reveal2: §b§oI am not a goddess. I am not a patron. I am a fact about the world, the oldest one. The blood-cult has spent millennia trying to bury me.
hemomancy.lady.tainted.v0.follow: §b§o[The sensation passes as quickly as it came. Only the cold remains, along with the faint smell of still water.]
hemomancy.lady.tainted.v0.line1: §b§o[A chill settles over you, still as a frozen lake. Somewhere, very far away, you hear running water.]
hemomancy.lady.tainted.v1.line1: §b§o[The air around you grows quiet. For just a moment, the weight of the blood feels... lighter.]
hemomancy.lady.tainted.v2.follow: §b§o[The feeling withdraws, like a tide going out. You are not certain whether to feel comforted or unsettled.]
hemomancy.lady.tainted.v2.line1: §b§o[Your skin prickles. Something is watching. It has no malice, only the patient regard of deep water.]
hemomancy.lady.vigilant.v0.follow1: §b§oI will not tell you whether to fight them or flee them. That is your choice to make.
hemomancy.lady.vigilant.v0.follow2: §b§oWhat I will tell you is this: you are harder to hurt now than you were. Silver Ward is not merely protection. It is a declaration. You have chosen a side.
hemomancy.lady.vigilant.v0.line1: §b§oHalf of the clarity path is behind you now. You begin to see through walls, not physically, but in the way that matters more.
hemomancy.lady.vigilant.v0.line2: §b§oThe Harbingers will try to reclaim you eventually. They always do. When they come, you will know them before they speak.
hemomancy.lady.vigilant.v1.line1: §b§oThe world is more complicated than the blood-cult would have you believe. The cult sees only the blood. You have begun to see what the blood was supposed to hide.
hemomancy.lady.vigilant.v1.line2: §b§oThere is something older than hemomancy beneath all of this. I trust you have begun to suspect what it might be.
hemomancy.lady.vigilant.v2.follow: §b§oClarity is not a destination. It is a lens you do not set down. Even at the path's end, you will keep seeing more.
hemomancy.lady.vigilant.v2.line1: §b§o[The cold presence is almost warm now, if cold can be warm, like the first frost of autumn that reminds you the fire is lit inside.]
hemomancy.ledger.disband.ledger_burned: Your ancestral ledger burns to ash and vanishes. (%s removed)
hemomancy.ledger.disband.member_notice: %s has dissolved the covenant. Your bloodline has been disbanded.
hemomancy.ledger.disband.missing: This bloodline no longer exists. Your ledger now lies empty.
hemomancy.ledger.disband.no_bloodline: You have no bloodline to disband.
hemomancy.ledger.disband.not_leader: Only the bloodline leader may dissolve the covenant.
hemomancy.ledger.disband.success: The covenant is broken. %d player member(s) and %d recruited Harbinger(s) have been released.
hemomancy.ledger.recall.no_bloodline: You have no bloodline. Found one by rite or join an existing covenant first.
hemomancy.ledger.recall.no_lodge: Your bloodline has no Founding Fane. Complete the Rite of the Founding Fane to establish one.
hemomancy.ledger.recall.not_leader: Only the bloodline leader may relocate the recall point.
hemomancy.ledger.recall.out_of_range: You must be within your Founding Fane to set the recall point.
hemomancy.ledger.recall.point_set: The Founding Fane recall point has been moved to your current position.
hemomancy.ledger.recall.success: The blood calls you home. You appear within the Founding Fane.
hemomancy.ledger.summon.already_near: All recruited Harbingers are already nearby.
hemomancy.ledger.summon.no_bloodline: You have no bloodline. Found one by rite or join an existing covenant first.
hemomancy.ledger.summon.no_npcs: No Harbingers have been recruited to your bloodline yet.
hemomancy.ledger.summon.not_in_lodge: You must be standing within your bloodline's Founding Fane to summon your recruits.
hemomancy.ledger.summon.success: %d recruited Harbinger(s) have been summoned to your side.
hemomancy.ledger.summon.searching: Calling your sworn recruits from their outposts. Hold your place in the Fane.
hemomancy.ledger.summon.unavailable: Some sworn recruits did not answer. Check their outposts or try again later.
hemomancy.lethean_tide.end: §b§lThe Lethean Tide sweeps the sky clean. The Blood Moon is gone.
hemomancy.living_staff.bond_unlocked: A Living Staff answers your blood.
hemomancy.machine_access.locked: Craft a %s yourself to use it. Fane membership does not grant personal mastery.
hemomancy.machine_access.no_loot: The %s comes apart without yielding its workings.
hemomancy.manipulation.activation_potent: Charges a radial electrical discharge. Charge strengthens damage; confirmed hits interrupt actions for 10 ticks without slowing movement. Water, iron and copper carry current.
hemomancy.manipulation.black_veil_covena: Raises a black veil of synthetic darkness for thirty seconds, Obscuring those caught inside as it falls. While you stand within your own veil you gain Resistance and fire protection at the cost of weakness. Cannot be recast while the veil stands.
Readies the staff to draw blood from valid targets.
hemomancy.manipulation.blood_aneurysm.de: Ruptures the nearest visible hostile vessel: a monster, a mob hunting you, or a player you may harm. Consumes Sanguine Pressure for up to 2 additional damage per level, scaled by charge. Fails without cost if no hostile is in reach.
hemomancy.manipulation.blood_lattice.des: Spreads an aimed binding lattice through a packed group of nearby creatures.
hemomancy.manipulation.blood_cloud.desc: Hurls a blood cloud that settles over the ground and wounds creatures beneath it. Its first touch on each creature builds Sanguine Pressure; later touches only wound.
hemomancy.manipulation.blood_eclipse_man: Retired compatibility entry; its defensive tradeoff now belongs to Black Veil Covenant.
hemomancy.manipulation.blood_eclipse.des: Obscures enemy perception beyond four blocks. Close defense remains possible; Illumination pierces school concealment.
hemomancy.manipulation.blood_lamp.desc: Places a small blood-made light in dark spaces.
hemomancy.manipulation.blood_needle.desc: Hardens blood into iron barbs and looses them in a rapid volley.
Scatters a broad fan of blood needles across a wider area.
hemomancy.manipulation.blood_needle_lanc: Fully charge to forge the volley into three barbed iron needles that pierce several bodies and briefly pin what they strike.
Readies the staff to feed blood into structures and machines.
hemomancy.manipulation.blood_rush.desc: Floods your body with quickening blood for eight seconds, increasing speed and attack speed and healing half a health point each second.
hemomancy.manipulation.blood_shot.desc: Fires a condensed blood projectile at the target.
hemomancy.manipulation.canopy_mortis.des: Carries Lignum Mortis between trees through touching leaves without harvesting leaves. Release or complete the selection to harvest.
hemomancy.manipulation.chain_blood_bindi: Chains a shorter binding from the first victim into nearby creatures.
hemomancy.manipulation.bloom_of_rot.desc: Erupts Putriciel's bloom through every body you may harm within eight blocks, dealing 3 damage and Necrosis. The rot spares no one: it poisons you as well.
hemomancy.manipulation.cauterizing_rebuk: Burns Poison, Wither, Necrosis and Blood Loss out of your body at one health apiece, then flares at enemies within four blocks with fire damage and Searing, without setting them alight.
hemomancy.manipulation.conductive_mark.d: Marks a preferred discharge target for twelve seconds. Later allied Ductilis, Lux or Ferric hits arc into nearby enemies. The mark itself does not electrify terrain.
hemomancy.manipulation.conjure_axe.desc: Reshapes a held Living Staff into a Living Axe.
hemomancy.manipulation.conjure_blade.des: Reshapes a held Living Staff into a Living Blade.
hemomancy.manipulation.conjure_claws.des: Reshapes a held Living Staff into living claws.
Reshapes a held Living Staff into a Living Crossbow.
hemomancy.manipulation.conjure_flail.des: Reshapes a held Living Staff into a Living Flail.
hemomancy.manipulation.conjure_sickle.de: Calls Vesper's disciplined refusal into the shape of a Living Sickle.
hemomancy.manipulation.conjure_spear.des: Reshapes a held Living Staff into a Living Spear.
hemomancy.manipulation.conjure_staff.des: Conjures a Living Staff into your hand.
hemomancy.manipulation.conjure_torch.des: Reshapes a held Living Staff into a Living Torch.
hemomancy.manipulation.crimson_flame_con: Places crimson flame where the blood points.
hemomancy.manipulation.crimson_harvest.d: Coaxes crops and living growth with a crimson surge.
hemomancy.manipulation.crimson_sight.des: Grants night vision and marks nearby creatures through darkness.
hemomancy.manipulation.crimson_tithe.des: Borrows 500 blood into the shared reserve for thirty seconds. Spent reserve incurs double blood repayment and six health damage; unused blood is reclaimed.
hemomancy.manipulation.cryogenic_pulse.d: Releases a cold pulse that deals freeze damage to nearby enemies and builds Rime in their blood.
hemomancy.manipulation.deadly_gaze.desc: Lifts what you look at; a full charge interrupts and slams the target.
hemomancy.manipulation.endless_hour.desc: Defers lethal damage at one health point for ten seconds. The unpaid damage returns as one hit when the hour ends or you leave the world. Armor, effects and absorption do not soften it, but a Totem of Undying or Phoenix Debt can still answer it.
hemomancy.manipulation.expansive_blood_c: Hurls a larger blood cloud, four blocks in radius, that briefly blankets a wider area.
hemomancy.manipulation.expulsive_updraft: Launches you only a little way but bursts outward, scorching nearby enemies with fire and Searing and throwing them aside. Needs footing.
hemomancy.manipulation.exsanguinate.desc: Executes a visible, badly wounded blood-bearing enemy and restores 250 blood only on a kill. Bosses cannot be executed outright: the drain against them is capped at twelve health points, scaled by Crimson Mastery.
Retired compatibility entry; Ferric Transmutation owns the alloy-buff identity.
hemomancy.manipulation.ferric_transmutat: Hardens blood into ferric force, empowering strikes and siphon effects.
hemomancy.manipulation.glacial_bastion.d: Retired compatibility entry; crouch-cast Glacial Rampart for its ice shell.
hemomancy.manipulation.glacial_circulati: Chills your blood to resist fire while slowing movement.
hemomancy.manipulation.glacial_grasp.des: Freezes source water along an aimed path and adds two Rime levels to targets wet from water or rain. Dry targets in the path take light freeze damage and one Rime level. Rime slows movement, not attacks or casting.
hemomancy.manipulation.glacial_rampart.d: Raises an aimed ice wall for twelve seconds, or a surrounding ice shell while crouching.
hemomancy.manipulation.grave_debt.desc: Marks a target with a debt that bursts at low health and refunds blood if death claims it.
hemomancy.manipulation.blackhearted.desc: While enabled with active blood and sufficient Mortem alignment, converts most Wither harm into recovery until necrotic saturation ruptures.
hemomancy.manipulation.hematic_beacon.de: Creates an aimed rally zone that mends allies a little and steadies them with brief Resistance each second, while Illuminating any creature or player inside that you may harm.
hemomancy.manipulation.hematic_impressme: Interrupts one blood-bearing creature and leashes its nerves to yours, impressing it into defending you and your allies for a time.
hemomancy.manipulation.hematic_rebuke.de: Jolts a command down a blood-bearing creature's nerves: it stops what it was doing, drops its target and flees for eight seconds.
hemomancy.manipulation.cruor_javelin.des: Hurls a shaft of frozen cruor at the creature you aim at, dealing freeze damage and driving two Rime levels into it, or three if it is wet from water or rain.
hemomancy.manipulation.fruiting_contagio: Every nearby enemy already carrying Necrosis is wracked and withered, and its rot spreads Necrosis to other enemies close by. Fails if no rot has taken root.
hemomancy.manipulation.searing_lash.desc: Cracks a whip of boiling blood against the creature you aim at, scalding and igniting it and laying a long Searing that primes Vitric Combustion for its full detonation bonus.
hemomancy.manipulation.umbral_rend.desc: Tears open every Obscured enemy before you at once. The shadow already clinging to them is spent for extra damage and leaves them bleeding. Fails if nothing ahead is Obscured.
Rakes the creature before you with a short slash of shadow and leaves it bleeding. It bites deeper while you are unseen or standing in darkness; Illumination strips that edge.
hemomancy.manipulation.radiant_wake.desc: While held, radiance holds you aloft: falling turns into a glide along your gaze. Each pulse mends you and nearby allies, bites enemies already Illuminated, and leaves nearby enemies Illuminated.
hemomancy.manipulation.lodestone_collaps: Charge to magnetise a point ahead. Every enemy in reach with a clear line to the point is dragged into it and crushed; walls shield. Lodestone and deep Rime in their blood collapse for extra damage, and a full charge pins them.
hemomancy.manipulation.hematic_riposte.d: A clawed blood-arm erupts from your back and slaps across your front. Hits from ahead within the swing are turned aside: melee attackers are stunned, projectiles are swatted away, and a successful parry cuts the cooldown short.
hemomancy.manipulation.hematic_mortar.de: Fully charge to lob one heavy blood shot in an arc before it bursts across a small area.
hemomancy.manipulation.hemolymphal_pulse: Sends a sensory impulse through nearby blood-bearing bodies you could harm, revealing them and marking wounded targets. You, your allies and your pets are not revealed. Does not electrify terrain.
hemomancy.manipulation.hemorrhage.desc: Inflicts twelve seconds of Blood Loss on the nearest visible enemy and seeds Necrosis in the wound for Mortem follow-ups.
hemomancy.manipulation.hemosynthesis.des: Turns blood into restorative living energy.
hemomancy.manipulation.insatiable_hunger: Bites a target for 2 damage that seeds Necrosis, then curses its recovery, reducing healing and turning food into gnawing hunger.
hemomancy.manipulation.lignum_mortis.des: Threads blood through connected wood and fungus. Release to harvest marked blocks; a completed selection automatically harvests and ends the channel.
hemomancy.manipulation.lingering_blood_b: Forms a longer-lived binding around one creature.
hemomancy.manipulation.iron_retort.desc: Raises a brief iron guard that cuts incoming melee damage and lashes back at the attacker.
hemomancy.manipulation.ironhearted.desc: Fully charge to store up to two Iron Hearts (4 health) for ten minutes. Stored hearts take damage first; active Thorn, Anvil, and Crucible scars expand capacity.
message.hemomancy.ironhearted.charge: Hold the manipulation until the iron heart finishes forming.
message.hemomancy.ironhearted.full: Your iron casing cannot hold another heart.
message.hemomancy.blackhearted.passive: Blackhearted is a passive; toggle it with the manipulation key.
hemomancy.manipulation.lumen_suture.desc: Sutures the nearest wounded ally with light: heals one heart, grants brief absorption, and clears Blindness, Wither, Necrosis and Obscured. Falls back to yourself.
hemomancy.manipulation.osseous_bloom.des: Crystallises the blood of every enemy within six blocks, dealing a quarter of its current health as freeze damage and building Rime. Best as an opener, not a finisher. Boss damage is capped at twelve health points. Fails without cost if no enemy is in reach.
hemomancy.manipulation.prismatic_reproof: Projects a cone of Lux for 4 damage, or 8 against a previously Illuminated target. Consumes Illumination without reapplying it.
hemomancy.manipulation.pyretic_forge.des: Smelts held items with fevered blood.
hemomancy.manipulation.sanguine_excavati: Breaks a compact cluster of blocks along your line of sight.
hemomancy.manipulation.sanguine_ignition: Scorches every body within five blocks with superheated blood and sets it alight for two seconds. Wet, rimed, fire-immune or fire-resistant bodies are not set alight.
hemomancy.manipulation.sanguine_magnetis: Raises an anchored iron pillar for six seconds, pulling enemies inward and pinning nearby bodies. When it falls, it slams every enemy it pulled within three blocks for 4 Ferric damage, or 6 if Lodestoned. Ductilis can energize the pillar to relay shocks into nearby enemies.
Cheaply repairs the damaged gear held in your hand.
hemomancy.manipulation.sanguine_ward.des: Channels a reactive electrical sheath. Incoming damage consumes its protection pool and jolts any direct attacker; later paid pulses slowly replenish it. A ward recast within five seconds of lapsing resumes its depleted pool; after longer it starts fresh.
Superheats the air beneath your feet, launching you upward and scorching nearby foes. Needs footing: ground, water or a ladder.
hemomancy.manipulation.guided_blood_shot: Steers a blood shot toward the creature nearest your aim.
hemomancy.manipulation.pursuing_blood_cl: Creates a compact blood cloud that slowly follows nearby enemies.
hemomancy.manipulation.sanguine_halo.des: Suspends five blood shots around you to seek nearby hostiles one at a time. Passive animals, pets and villagers are ignored.
Seeds a broad, stationary storm cloud whose blood lightning strikes the nearest creature beneath it each second, without igniting the world.
hemomancy.manipulation.soaring_updraft.d: Launches you faster and higher, carrying some of your forward momentum. Needs footing.
hemomancy.manipulation.suspended_updraft: Launches you into a brief levitating pause before slow falling takes hold. Needs footing.
hemomancy.manipulation.summon_avatar.des: Manifests the Blood Avatar around your own body while you sustain it, turning aside a quarter of incoming harm. The void, /kill and starvation pass through it.
hemomancy.manipulation.summon_avatar_arm: Manifests the avatar's arms, strengthening your blows while it shelters you.
Manifests an armored torso with greater protection and the avatar's striking arms.
hemomancy.manipulation.summon_avatar_leg: Manifests the avatar through its legs, increasing movement and step height.
hemomancy.manipulation.summon_avatar_com: Manifests the complete Blood Avatar at its greatest protection, strength, and speed.
hemomancy.manipulation.summon_thrall.des: Raises a blood thrall from a suitable source block.
hemomancy.manipulation.synaptic_jolt.des: Shocks a nearby target and interrupts actions for 10 ticks without slowing movement. Can energize water, iron, copper or an owned Ferric construct.
hemomancy.manipulation.umbral_reversal.d: Reverses backward into a nearby dark space and Obscures enemies left behind.
hemomancy.manipulation.umbral_step.desc: Steps to a safe, supported shadow beside or above the targeted block.
hemomancy.manipulation.unclosing_eye.des: Persistently strips nearby concealment with Seraphae's unforgiving sight.
Scans nearby ore veins and reports their count plus the nearest ore and its coordinates.
hemomancy.manipulation.venous_travel.des: Travel along prepared venous paths between linked blood structures.
hemomancy.manipulation.vital_effusion.de: Spends blood to stir living growth in nearby plants.
hemomancy.manipulation.vital_reservoir.d: Drains life from a wounded target and returns blood to you.
hemomancy.manipulation.vitric_combustion: Detonates superheated blood. Consumes remaining Searing heat for up to 4 additional damage.
hemomancy.manipulation.worked_lignum.des: Extends Lignum Mortis into tagged worked materials such as wooden planks. Release or complete the selection to harvest.
hemomancy.manipulation.void_shroud.desc: Veils you in shadow for five seconds with speed and night vision. Attacking breaks the Veil, and Illumination exposes it.
hemomancy.memory_of_vesper.already_awake: Vesper's refusal is already disciplined within your staff-bond.
hemomancy.memory_of_vesper.awakened: Vesper's memory settles into your Living Staff bond.
hemomancy.memory_of_vesper.inactive: The memory finds no living current to discipline.
hemomancy.memory_of_vesper.no_bond: The memory refuses a hand without a Living Staff bond.
hemomancy.memory_of_vesper.rite_guidance: Place this in an Iron Brazier, then channel Blood Absorption through a Living Staff.
hemomancy.milestone.adept_ascension.desc: Ascend to Adept of the Sanguine Brotherhood. The blood has taken root.
hemomancy.milestone.altar_blessing.desc: Receive the one-time blessing of Our Lady at an Altar of Cleansing
hemomancy.milestone.apotheos_ascension.d: Ascend to Apotheos of the Hematic Order. The final hush opens.
hemomancy.milestone.archon_ascension.des: Ascend to Archon of the Hematic Order
hemomancy.milestone.first_manipulation.d: Use a blood manipulation for the first time
hemomancy.milestone.first_morphling_bond: Equip a morphling companion for the first time
hemomancy.milestone.first_rite.desc: Complete a cardinal rite for the first time
hemomancy.milestone.illuminatus_ascensio: Ascend to Illuminatus of the Crimson Lodge. Something stirs in the deep channels.
hemomancy.milestone.initiate_ascension.d: Ascend to Initiate of the Incarnadine Fane
hemomancy.milestone.our_lady_of_still_wa: Obtain the Icon of Our Lady
hemomancy.milestone.sanctified_ascension: Ascend to Sanctified of the Bloodline Covenant. The network grows. Can you feel it?
Accept formal initiation from the Vicar
hemomancy.milestone.votary_ascension.des: Ascend to Votary of the Hematic Covenant
hemomancy.mnemonist.clarity.line1: The silence around you is bright. Painfully bright.
hemomancy.mnemonist.clarity.line2: Ask, if you must. I remember the path you left, but I will not hand its living lessons back to you.
hemomancy.mnemonist.crude_memories.line1: Crude memories are early echoes. Use one, pay the blood cost, and the manipulation settles into your known lessons.
hemomancy.mnemonist.crude_memories.line2: If you have an empty active slot, the echo will step into it on its own. If every slot is full, it waits in your library until you learn to arrange yourself.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_hint: Open what you carry. I will tell you which objects remember, and which merely pretend.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.crude_m: Blood Lamp. Lux makes witness of the dark.
A humble echo, and a good one. Light is often the first mercy a Harbinger learns to make.
Blood Rush. The body remembers panic and calls it speed.
Use it as an early lesson in movement, but mind the cost. Fast blood is still blood spent.
Blood Shot. A simple lesson: pressure, release, and a line drawn through the air.
Let it teach you only after initiation. If an active slot is empty, it will rise to the surface by itself.
Crimson Harvest. Ductilis remembers work: draw, gather, take what the vein can use.
A good field lesson. It teaches the blood that utility can be as sacred as violence.
Deadly Gaze. An ugly little echo, but useful: intent carried through the eyes before the hand moves.
It is crude, not harmless. Look carefully at anything you teach your blood to hate.
Glacial Grasp. Congeatio slows the world until a mistake can be studied.
A cold lesson, but not an unfeeling one. Stillness can save you.
Hemorrhage. Mortem knows how endings begin: a small opening, then insistence.
Treat this lesson with restraint. The blood keeps cruel habits easily.
Sanguine Ignition. Flammeus remembers fever, spark, and the red thought before flame.
It is eager. Let eagerness stay separate from mastery.
Sanguine Mending. Ferric memory is fond of repair, though it asks payment first.
A wound gives, the reserve answers. That is the exchange.
Void Shroud. Tenebris teaches the blood to pull the dark close and breathe quietly beneath it.
Some lessons hide you from enemies. Some hide you from yourself. Learn the difference.
Hematic Flare. Lux stretches the blood thin and white until whatever hides from you stands lit.
Light is not mercy. It only refuses to let anything go unseen, you included.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.hematic: A blank hematic memory is a cup waiting for a voice.
The Loom can fill it with a deliberate lesson, if your degree and materials are ready.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.living_: This is a limb-pattern, not an arsenal ledger. The staff will still answer only through your known manipulations.
Perform the matching deed, craft the graft, then let the Brazier burn it while your staff drinks the memory.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.memory_: Black Veil Covenant. Tenebris made visible, a chapel of dark blood and branching veins.
Within its sphere, shadow is no metaphor. Step through it carefully.
Blood Absorption. Utility is no weakness.
This lesson teaches you to draw what spilled power remains. It belongs early, when every reserve matters.
Blood Eclipse Mantle. A defensive eclipse drawn close enough to bruise the ribs.
It protects, but it asks your strength to kneel while the shadow hardens.
Blood Projection. The outward hand of the same first doctrine.
Absorb and project: intake and offering. Most Harbingers learn those two before they learn pride.
A refined Blood Rush memory. It has fewer burrs than the crude shard and spends its lesson more cleanly.
Remember the crude version that taught your body how to begin.
A refined Blood Shot memory. Cleaner than a scraped echo, but still the same first line of force.
Full memories obey their rank gates. The crystal may be ready before the practitioner is.
Blood Binding. A simple restraint, if one accepts that another body is only blood taught to stay.
The tendrils begin at your feet. Keep your footing, and they will teach the target the same stillness.
Cauterizing Rebuke. Flammeus is sometimes medicine, if one accepts the smell of burning.
It sears venom and rot from the caster, then answers nearby enemies in kind.
Conductive Mark. A patient sign, bright enough for allied blood-work to find.
Ductilis, Lux, and Ferric blows can catch the mark and leap outward into nearby enemies.
A refined Deadly Gaze memory. The lesson has been given shape instead of scraped from old panic.
Refinement steadies a memory. It can still carry an ugly lesson.
A full memory crystal. This one is stable, deliberate, and fit for proper loadout work.
Refined memories keep their shape longer than crude shards. Carry them with intent, not curiosity.
Glacial Rampart. Congeatio remembers how cold can stand upright when blood gives it a spine.
It is a brief refusal placed between you and harm, a wall that buys you time.
Gloam Laceration. Tenebris keeps a knife where the light forgets to look.
It bites deepest from a shroud or true darkness, and what it opens keeps bleeding after.
Grave Debt. A Mortem ledger written against a living balance.
When the vessel falls low it bursts, and death may return a measure of blood to the creditor.
Blackhearted. Mortem teaches the heart to feed on the death meant for it.
The feast has a limit. When the vessel saturates, the debt breaks inward and the lesson goes silent.
Hematic Beacon. The blood remembers signal fires carried under the skin.
Allies steady beneath it. Hostiles become easier for the covenant to name.
Hematic Impressment. A borrowed loyalty written directly into another pulse.
Only one vessel can bear your command, and stronger blood sheds it sooner.
Hematic Rebuke. A command sent down another body's nerves, so it remembers fear before any blade is drawn.
Bloodless bodies and greater wills have nothing this lesson can command.
Cruor Javelin. Congeatio does not wait for the river; it carries its own cold and throws it.
What it strikes stiffens. Iron finishes what the frost begins.
Fruiting Contagion. Mortem never ends with one wound. Rot that has taken hold remembers how to fruit.
It cannot start a rot, only hurry one along. Something must already be dying.
Searing Lash. Flammeus remembers that heat travels best along something that can be swung.
It marks what it strikes for a greater burning. Do not lash anything you are not willing to finish.
Umbral Rend. Tenebris lays the dark on first; this lesson only closes the hand around what is already held.
Without shadow already on them, it finds nothing to tear. Patience is the whole of the technique.
Radiant Wake. Lux stretched so thin it bears your weight. The light does not lift you; it simply refuses to let you fall.
It keeps whoever stands near you mended and everything hostile exposed. Being seen is the price of the sky.
Lodestone Collapse. Ferric fixed iron into their blood long before this. Here you only call it home.
Everything drawn in is drawn in together. Mind where you stand when the iron answers.
Hematic Riposte. The blood remembers a limb the body never grew, and it answers faster than the hand you own.
It only guards what you face, and only for a heartbeat. Mistime it and the blood is spent on air.
Hematic Flare. Lux learns to strike without first asking the dark to confess.
It brands what hides, burns what is caught, and turns concealment into a wound.
Insatiable Hunger. Mortem teaches appetite to eat its own remedy.
Healing thins under it, and food becomes a deeper ache instead of comfort.
Iron Retort. Ferric patience folded into a single answer.
The guard accepts the first bite, dulls it, then answers through the attacker's own opening.
Ironhearted. Ferric blood remembers a second pulse and builds it a silver cage.
Hold the memory steady until the metal closes. Its borrowed heart is spent before your own.
Lumen Suture. Lux can reveal a room, or place a needle of light where you need one.
It closes pain with a pale thread and cuts blindness from the wound.
Prismatic Reproof. Lux can judge a threat by splitting it into every color it tried to hide.
It strikes harder against prey already exposed by Illumination, spending that light in the judgment.
Sanguine Magnetism. Ferric blood remembers where iron wants to gather.
A pillar rises, and hostile bodies are dragged close enough to learn stillness.
Scalding Updraft. Blood remembers hot air rising under a storm-black roof.
Stand on the breath of fire. Let it throw you where legs fail.
Synaptic Jolt. Ductilis can stop the nerve as readily as it moves the body.
A short bolt interrupts, staggers, and leaves the struck vessel briefly unable to answer cleanly.
Umbral Reversal. When pursuit grows too certain, the blood learns to answer from behind itself.
It needs darkness to catch you, or a Veil willing to pretend the world has none.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.minecra: A mundane vessel of knowledge, but not a useless one. Archives begin with ordinary pages.
Bring enough of these and even blood-memory can be indexed instead of guessed.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.mnemoni: Blank, but not ignorant. A blueprint waits for spatial memory rather than a manipulation lesson.
A rite has been impressed here as remembered distance, order, and relation. It maps the rite without carrying its authority.
A blood structure has been fixed into portable recollection. It can guide the hand. Understanding still belongs to you.
The Mnemonic Reliquary arranges Thelemic and Noetic Memories within one active loadout.
The Reliquary chooses which known lessons wait nearest the pulse. The memory item teaches new ones.
The Reliquary is a Third Degree weave. Until then, let the first bodily lessons settle into the open places nearest your pulse.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.orb_of_: A fixed eye for a room made from memory. Its skies come from places its owner has truly reached. There is no invention in it.
Cast it beyond the Chamber floor. The fall changes the remembered perspective, and the Orb returns to the hand that owns the cell.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.puppete: Enthralling Filament. Peacock Spiders, surface Hemojellies and Blood Drunk Puppeteers supply this restraint fibre. The Somatic Loom weaves it into memory; the Spindle stores its tension for a Crossbar.
Keep it. The second degree can study the fibre, but the first true string waits until the Mnemonist has taught you how memory is prepared.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.salt_st: Salt ruins paper faster than blood ruins memory. Hold it still. There: current marks, specimen counts, a prayer before descent.
The last line asks you to use what we learned if we fail to surface. That is what remains of us.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.scar_pa: A scar pattern schema: instruction for flesh, tendency, and threshold.
Patterns carry no power on their own. They give the blood a grammar, then the blood decides whether it can speak the sentence.
An unwritten motif. The Effigy has not yet persuaded blood to leave a route upon it.

Several known routes share this motif. Place it in an empty Iron Brazier, light it with Blood Projection, then hold Blood Absorption on the offering. The commit costs 50 mL and replaces your active cerebral loadout.
A single scar route is written here: a carving lesson for the Cerebral Scarring Station.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.somatic: The Somatic Loom weaves deliberate blood memories from tendency inputs, blood, and pattern.
A crude shard is a found echo. A Loom-woven crystal is a lesson made on purpose.
The Somatic Loom will not open its discipline to you before the third degree. Scraped echoes must carry you a little longer.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.unknown: That object has no lesson I can hear. Or it is wise enough to keep quiet.
hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.line1: The Somatic Loom is where scraped echoes give way to deliberate recollection.
hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.line2: Pay its blood and an engram unfurls around it: an eight-pointed star, the memory's fragments waiting at its points. They are pieces of what some Harbinger before you once knew. Thread each one home along the star's lines with your staff, and never let two colours cross.
hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.line3: Not every fragment is true. The blood keeps its failures as faithfully as its lessons. Rest your eyes on a fragment and it will show you its memory; a false one shows you someone else's, and beats against the loom instead of with it.
hemomancy.mnemonist.scriptorium.role: The Loom weaves a memory you can learn. The Scriptorium inscribes equipment instead. It is an optional workshop, not part of the Woven Vessel.
hemomancy.mnemonist.scriptorium.material: Build the base station around an Enchanting Table with Sanguine Glass and Hematic Iron Blocks. Hold a Ferric Binder; offer an Enzyme Primer, Blood Crystal Shard, Lapis Block, and 500 mL of blood.
hemomancy.mnemonist.scriptorium.eightfol: At the fifth Degree, the Rite of the Eightfold Script rules its lines in red, so one inscription can be singled out and raised above the rest.
hemomancy.mnemonist.scriptorium.palimpse: At the seventh Degree, the Rite of the Palimpsest scrapes the page back to what the blood remembers, so the chosen inscription can be cut deeper than ink allows.
hemomancy.mnemonist.scriptorium.rubricat: Ask for the quill that marks one line in red.
Write something at a Scriptorium first, and keep your blood awake. At the fifth Degree I will lend you the quill the old rubricators used.
You have written, and the page remembers your hand. Take the quill, and set it with five more offerings at the Rite of the Eightfold Script.
The quill is yours already. If you need another, you know now how it is cut.
hemomancy.mnemonist.scriptorium.palimpse: Ask for the burin that writes over what was written.

First learn ordinary inscription, then single out an inscription at an Eightfold Scriptorium yourself. At the seventh Degree, with your blood awake, the burin will cut where the quill only marked. You need not have accepted my quill.
You have chosen a line and made it stay. Take the burin to the Rite of the Palimpsest, with five more offerings, and cut it deeper.
The burin is already yours. Memory does not hand out the same edge twice, but you know now how to shape another.
hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.ganglionic.prom: Ask for the harness that lets the loom hear its own engram.
hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.ganglionic.requ: Weave one memory home at a Somatic Loom first, every fragment threaded, and keep your blood awake. At the fifth Degree I will give you a harness of nerve, so the loom can hold memories a Magister made.
hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.ganglionic.read: You have threaded a memory home and kept it. Take the harness, and set it with five more offerings at the Rite of the Ganglionic Weave.
hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.ganglionic.clai: The harness is yours already. A loom that has learned to feel does not forget; if you need another, you know how the nerve is bound.
hemomancy.vicar.condenser.lattice.title: The Clotting Lattice
hemomancy.vicar.condenser.lattice.prompt: Ask for the lattice that teaches a cauldron to hold more.
hemomancy.vicar.condenser.lattice.requir: Bring me proof you have drawn a formation from a cauldron with your own hands, and keep your blood awake. At the third Degree the lattice is yours.
hemomancy.vicar.condenser.lattice.ready: You have fed a cauldron and taken what it set. Take the lattice, and seat it with five more offerings at the Rite of the First Clotting.
hemomancy.vicar.condenser.lattice.claime: The Order has already given you its lattice. If you need another, scrap and ash will bind one.
hemomancy.vicar.condenser.druse.title: The Druse Heart
hemomancy.vicar.condenser.druse.prompt: Ask for the heart that lines a Condenser in crystal.
hemomancy.vicar.condenser.druse.requirem: Draw a formation from a Latticed Condenser yourself and reach the fifth Degree. Then the crystal heart is yours, and nothing you set will slump away again.
hemomancy.vicar.condenser.druse.ready: Your lattice has served. Take the heart, and close three circuits at the Rite of Druse Crystallization.
hemomancy.vicar.condenser.druse.claimed: You carry the Order's heart already. Another can be grown from glass, amethyst and blood crystal.
hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.cortical.title: The Cortical Crown
hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.cortical.prompt: Ask for the crown that lets the loom think the whole memory.
hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.cortical.requir: First weave a Magister's memory on a Ganglionic Loom yourself. At the sixth Degree, with your blood awake, the crown lets the loom carry a Perfectus memory at full stature. You need not have accepted my harness.
hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.cortical.ready: The echo stood taller for you than for most. Take the crown to the Rite of the Cortical Weave, with five more offerings, and let the loom see the whole of what it recalls.
hemomancy.mnemonist.loom.cortical.claime: The crown is already yours. There is only so much mind a loom can wear; you know now how another is folded.
hemomancy.loom.tier_required.1: This memory is too refined for this loom. It needs a Ganglionic Loom.
hemomancy.loom.tier_required.2: This memory is too refined for this loom. It needs a Cortical Loom.
hemomancy.mnemonist.memory_practice.line: Choose the exact Loom recipe before paying blood. The blank vessel and catalyst shape the weave; stored enzymes alone do not choose the result.
The Reliquary arranges known Noetic and Thelemic memories within one active capacity. Changing the active set does not erase a learned memory.
hemomancy.mnemonist.distributor.line1: The Dendritic Distributor saves named arrangements of known Noetic and Thelemic memories. It does not teach them, and fixed Blood Absorption and Blood Projection stay outside custom patterns.
hemomancy.mnemonist.distributor.line2: Save or overwrite costs 100 mL of blood and 25 raw XP. Rename and apply are free. Three pattern slots are available before Synaptic Memory expands them.
hemomancy.mnemonist.distributor.line3: Applying checks your current capacity and known memories. It replaces the active arrangement and turns off any running Thelemic memory omitted from the saved pattern.
hemomancy.mnemonist.distributor.line4: To build one, strike Infested Venous Stone with a Sanguine Formation. Frame the central stone with four Iron Bars, then supply 500 mL of blood.
hemomancy.mnemonist.memory_lore.line1: Hematic Memory is repeatable instruction preserved in blood, not a whole life placed on a shelf.
hemomancy.mnemonist.memory_lore.line2: Some lessons are understood as patterns and projected through manipulation. Others are prepared in the body and enacted when its vessels answer.
hemomancy.dialogue.mnemonist.option.ask_: You said memory has three movements?
hemomancy.mnemonist.mnemonic_doctrine.li: Mneme keeps. Nous knows. Thelēma acts.
Memory preserves the trace. Intellect sees its pattern, and will enacts it. Noetic and Thelemic practice are two methods on one substrate.
We use the names as working distinctions. Their predictions are what earn their keep.
hemomancy.mnemonist.neophyte.line1: Neophyte. There you are. The first echoes have begun to gather around you.
hemomancy.mnemonist.neophyte.line2: Crude memories found in the old places still work. Use one and learn what it does. At Degree 2, bring me that experience and choose an echo deliberately.
hemomancy.mnemonist.purifying.line1: §7[The Mnemonist's eyes soften, but their hands fold closed.]
hemomancy.mnemonist.purifying.line2: You are trying to loosen the lessons from your blood. I will answer questions, but I will not press another echo into a wound you are trying to clean.
hemomancy.mnemonist.reliquary.line1: The Mnemonic Reliquary keeps lessons you have already survived. Use it as a careful shelf, and learn from the memories themselves.
hemomancy.mnemonist.reliquary.line2: Use it to arrange Noetic and Thelemic Memories in one active loadout. It changes what sits near the surface. The deeper library remains in you.
hemomancy.mnemonist.slots.line1: Your active mnemonic slots hold the Noetic and Thelemic lessons your blood can keep near the surface. Your whole memory reaches farther than those slots.
hemomancy.mnemonist.slots.line2: Early crude lessons may fill empty slots for you. Later, the Reliquary lets you decide which lessons sleep close to the pulse.
hemomancy.mnemonist.starter_choice.line1: Choose one crude memory to use in the field. If you already learned an echo, keep it; this choice does not erase it. I can place only one shard in your hand.
hemomancy.mnemonist.starter_choice.line2: Choose by instinct: reach, motion, or gaze.
hemomancy.mnemonist.uninitiated.line1: §7[A robed Harbinger presses two fingers to their own wrist, listening to a pulse you cannot hear.]
hemomancy.mnemonist.uninitiated.line2: Not yet. The blood remembers many lessons, but it keeps its mouth closed for an uncut heir. Return after initiation, and I will teach you to listen without being drowned.
hemomancy.mnemonist.votary.line1: Votary. Choose a crude memory for reach, motion, or gaze, then use it in the field. The Reliquary comes later; it will let you arrange the lessons you know.
hemomancy.mnemonist.woven_vessel.archive: Bring the blank vessel with a book, ink, and paper. I will index the first lesson, but the Loom must still do the weaving.
Make one blank Hematic Memory from four Sanguine Formations, four Blood Stained Stones, and one Neurotic Enzyme.

Find Blood Stained Stone in a Hermitage Remnant, or make each one from Venous Stone, a Sanguine Formation, and redstone. Four crafted stones bring the blank's total to eight formations. Chicken blood can yield Neurotic Enzyme, though some spins yield Vivacious instead.
hemomancy.mnemonist.woven.line1: Your blood has learned enough words that simple echoes are no longer enough.
hemomancy.mnemonist.woven.line2: The Loom weaves deliberate lessons thread by thread. A crystal can then teach without speaking.
hemomancy.monolith.archon.press_again: §7[The surface is warm enough now that it is uncomfortable to hold your hand against.]§r Press here again. Not many more times remain.
The cube separates from the Lodestone without breaking it. For a moment the absence has a sound.
The rack has been taught to hold blood. The Vicar taught it ceremony. Silence remains outside its lessons.
Take this small weight from me. Offer it at a lit brazier during the Rite of the Monolithic Armature. The consecrated frame will remember the shape of armor that no voice should wear.
hemomancy.monolith.guidance.adept: Adept, the Brotherhood recognises your blood. Seek the Sainted Mausoleums and draw from the preserved corpus within. The enzymes of Saints hold the key to the next rite.
hemomancy.monolith.guidance.adept.line1: §7[The surface hums faintly beneath your palm. The sound could come from machinery or something older.]
hemomancy.monolith.guidance.adept.line2: Adept. The Brotherhood recognises your blood. Seek the Sainted Mausoleums. Draw from the preserved corpus within. The Saints' enzymes hold what you need next.
hemomancy.monolith.guidance.archon: Archon... under your power the monolith begins to crack. Press further, and it may shatter into black shards.
hemomancy.monolith.guidance.archon.line1: I have been waiting for you specifically. Not someone similar. §oyou§r.
hemomancy.monolith.guidance.archon.line2: §7[A low sound comes from somewhere deep inside the stone. Not mechanical. Not settling. Something else.]
hemomancy.monolith.guidance.illuminatus: Illuminatus, the Crimson Lodge has opened its gates. Go deeper into the crimson fungal depths and commune with the Dendritic Distributors. The mycelial network whispers of dormant power.
§7[The stone is faintly warm where you touch it. That is new.]
Illuminatus. The Lodge's gates stand open. The mycelial network below your feet whispers of dormant power. You are beginning to hear it, I think.
hemomancy.monolith.guidance.sanctified: Sanctified of the Covenant, few have walked this far. Enter the Chamber of Will by your own rite and prepare for the judgment that makes an Archon.
hemomancy.monolith.guidance.sanctified.l: §7[Beneath your palm, the stone feels like something else.]
Sanctified of the Covenant. The Loom has taught deliberate memory. Now learn the inward room where memory, scar, and will become architecture.
hemomancy.monolith.item_hint: Present what you carry. I will answer only where it touches the threshold.
hemomancy.monolith.item_inquiry.fragment: Fragments of me are still warm with remembered pressure. They are quiet, but memory keeps moving through them.
Use them carefully. The shard carries no lesson of its own. It resonates.
