skill.hemomancy.base.desc: The root of your hemomantic potential.
skill.hemomancy.deep_base.desc: The inner root opens with the fifth degree. All deeper disciplines pass through this heart before branching outward.
skill.hemomancy.skill_ancestral_sovereig: The oldest covenant rites answer your authority. Improves domain-style covenant bonuses and ally support per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_arterial_cadence.d: Your draw matches the pressure of a trained artery. Reaches the mature Blood Absorption damage cadence.
skill.hemomancy.skill_automatic_coagulat: Spend blood over time to suppress active bleeding.
skill.hemomancy.skill_autonomous_retalia: Bound summons also retaliate when another puppet is attacked.
skill.hemomancy.skill_blood_flow.desc: Reduces manipulation cooldowns by 5% per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_blood_tolerance.de: Your vessels endure longer contact with stolen blood. Delays weakness, nausea, and blood poisoning from living-target absorption per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_bloodhound_sense.d: Sense nearby wounded, bleeding, and blood-rich creatures through cover.
skill.hemomancy.skill_bright_eyed.desc: Lux revelation reaches 10% farther and lasts 20% longer per level; Blindness and Darkness expire 20% faster per level.
The bloodline pool answers more cleanly. Improves shared pool draw and donation efficiency per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_bound_command.desc: The crossbar's tether holds longer and farther. Per level: +32 charge capacity, +4 blocks tether range, and +1 second unequipped grace.
skill.hemomancy.skill_coagulation.desc: +15% chance to block incoming bleed effects. Per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_crimson_mastery.de: The blood deepens its hold, branching through you like roots through soil. +15% manipulation damage/effectiveness per level. Lingering state damage (Searing, Blood Loss, Necrosis release) stays flat.
skill.hemomancy.skill_crimson_projection: The staff projects blood with finer pressure. Increases Living Staff structure and vessel feed rates per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_crimson_wake.desc: While badly wounded, sprinting leaves a brief slowing and revealing blood wake.
skill.hemomancy.skill_deep_inscription.d: Your tier-three scars accept deeper writing. Required for standard tier-three scar crafting and slightly extends tier-three scar effects.
skill.hemomancy.skill_deep_scar_resonanc: Permit equipped scars to express stronger secondary effects at greater upkeep.
skill.hemomancy.skill_distributed_siphon: Divide Blood Absorption across several targets without multiplying its total draw.
skill.hemomancy.skill_dormant_symbiote.d: Suspend morphling upkeep while its gifts are idle and it does not need bonding blood.
skill.hemomancy.skill_dragging_siphon.de: You learn to drag the rite with you. Allows very slow movement while channeling Blood Absorption.
skill.hemomancy.skill_dynamic_use.desc: Manipulations of your strongest tendency cost less blood: their cost is divided by 1 + 10% per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_efficiency.desc: Reduces manipulation blood cost by 8% per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_fane_suture.desc: Owned suture links route blood with less hesitation. Improves direct routing transfer and working reserve per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_far_tether.desc: +8 blocks of summon tether and hostile-acquisition range per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_feeding_frenzy.des: +25% blood gained from kills. Per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_fungal_symbiosis.d: Fungal scars answer as part of your body. Improves fungal scar scaling per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_guarded_feeding.de: Convert excess absorbed blood into temporary protection at reduced efficiency.
skill.hemomancy.skill_hematic_focus.desc: The Living Staff holds a steadier focus. Improves staff absorption and projection after the midgame staff loop is established.
skill.hemomancy.skill_hemostasis.desc: Reduces blood lost when taking damage by 10% per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_hungry_pulse.desc: The siphon bites in a steadier rhythm. Further increases living-target Blood Absorption pulse frequency.
skill.hemomancy.skill_hyphal_cultivation: Cultivated hyphae listen through carried bodies. Improves fungal morphling synergies per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_high_strung.desc: Toggle an over-tensioned puppet link. Per level, bodies move faster, strike sooner, and obey 4 blocks farther, but consume more thread and blood and recoil through you when destroyed.
skill.hemomancy.skill_iron_handed.desc: +0.5 melee knockback but -7.5% attack speed per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_iron_will.desc: 10% damage reduction per level when blood is below 15%.
skill.hemomancy.skill_last_wind.desc: Regenerate +0.5 mL/tick (10 mL/s) per level while below 10% blood.
skill.hemomancy.skill_light_footed.desc: In strong light, gain 5% movement speed and 0.15 step height per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_living_conduit.des: The Living Staff seats itself deeper in the vascular lesson. Increases staff absorption targets and range per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_living_sinew.desc: Bound summons gain +15% health and +10% damage per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_manip_slots.desc: +1 equipped manipulation slot per level. (Max 9 total; excess refunded as skill points.)
skill.hemomancy.skill_merciful_command.d: Bound summons stop attacking ordinary targets near defeat.
skill.hemomancy.skill_mobile_conduit.des: Your footing learns the conduit shape. Reduces the Blood Absorption channeling slowdown per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_nerves_of_steel.de: Reduce knockback and Slowness duration by 15-20% per level; damaged charged manipulations retain 25% more charge per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_persistent_arsenal: Living Weapon forms remain shaped when you leave their hotbar slot.
skill.hemomancy.skill_primal_morphogenes: The final morphling lesson becomes less ruinous. Reduces Morphic Strain and improves primal morphling bonuses.
skill.hemomancy.skill_puppet_skein.desc: +1 active bound summon per level. This cap is player-bound, not crossbar-bound.
skill.hemomancy.skill_qliphoth_gestation: Qliphoth fruit lingers in the blood. Improves pome empowerment duration and efficiency per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_quick_caster.desc: Selecting a quick manipulation from the radial wheel or cycle key casts it at once. Charged, channelled, passive, staff-form and conjuring manipulations still wait for the cast key.
skill.hemomancy.skill_quickened_draw.des: The first practiced cadence shortens the pause between Blood Absorption damage pulses.
skill.hemomancy.skill_reflexive_coagulat: Spend blood at the instant of injury to prevent severe bleeding from worsening.
skill.hemomancy.skill_sanguine_crystalli: Steadies a Sanguine Cauldron: reduces its collapse chance by 5% per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_sanguine_reach.des: The blood extends beyond you in tendrils of intent that reach further than any arm. Each level grants +15% range to ranged blood manipulations.
skill.hemomancy.skill_sanguine_reserve.d: Protect an emergency floor of blood from passive and automatic spending.
While holding your owner-attuned Crossbar, spend 10 blood each second to wind 1 thread charge. Sanguine Reserve protects its floor.
skill.hemomancy.skill_sanguine_surge.des: Passive blood regen of +0.25 mL/tick (5 mL/s) per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_sated_siphon.desc: Keep drawing blood from living targets at full blood volume, preserving Blood Absorption's damage pulse.
skill.hemomancy.skill_scar_affinity.desc: The mind opens to cerebral scarring, or perhaps the scars open pathways that were always there. +10% scar effect potency per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_scar_mastery.desc: The scarred pathways are fully colonised. Effects linger as if they have taken root. Scar effects last 20% longer per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_scar_resonance.des: The bond between scar and blood deepens. The inscriptions almost seem to breathe. +1 equippable scar slot per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_selective_hunger.d: Ignore passive, allied, and tamed creatures unless you aim directly at them.
skill.hemomancy.skill_servitor_tender.de: Drudges and thralls move blood with practiced hands. Improves servitor throughput and routing range per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_shared_siphon.desc: Share part of absorbed blood with bonded allies and bloodline routes.
skill.hemomancy.skill_skein_transpositio: The prepared skein may be transposed in the field. Unlocks the Crossbar's outer radial for atomic puppet hot-swapping.
skill.hemomancy.skill_sporitic_attunemen: The thurible's spores find your pulse. Improves Sporitic Thurible aura range and reduces blood upkeep per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_symbiotic_metaboli: A fed morphling can draw half its upkeep from your hunger while preserving a safe food floor.
skill.hemomancy.skill_synaptic_memory.de: The Dendritic Distributor teaches your blood to remember whole mnemonic patterns. +1 saved pattern slot per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_thread_economy.des: The crossbar spends charge with restraint. Reduces bound summon call and upkeep charge costs by 5% per level, to a 70% floor.
skill.hemomancy.skill_unbound_siphon.des: The siphon no longer roots your body. Removes Blood Absorption movement penalties.
skill.hemomancy.skill_vascular_draw.desc: The staff learns to draw without hesitation. Increases staff absorption amount and block or reservoir draw rate per level.
skill.hemomancy.skill_vascular_mercy.des: Ordinary Blood Absorption stops before killing its target.
skill.hemomancy.skill_vespers_refusal.de: Vesper's disciplined refusal amplifies the Living Staff's focus and unlocks its final inherited limb: the Living Sickle.
skill.hemomancy.skill_vital_link.desc: Something in the blood reaches back when you wound another, forming a thread to what you have spilled. Each level adds a 10% chance to heal when a manipulation deals damage.
skill.hemomancy.skill_weapons_master.des: The staff remembers the hand before the wound. Reduces Living Staff weapon hot-swap cost by 50mL per level.
subtitle.hemomancy.entity.stained_priest: The Stained Priestess flares her wings
The Stained Priestess draws the lancea
tooltip.hemomancy.barbed_set_bonus: Set Bonus (4): Barbed venom. Attackers take damage, Blood Loss, and Poison
tooltip.hemomancy.bloodlust_set_bonus: Set Bonus (4): Lifesteal. 10% of melee damage heals you
tooltip.hemomancy.bloodlust_lineage.barb: Matching lineage: lesser thorns, Blood Loss, and poison
tooltip.hemomancy.bloodlust_lineage.chit: Matching lineage: +1 toughness and 12.5% projectile defense
tooltip.hemomancy.bloodlust_lineage.pris: Matching lineage: lesser retaliatory prismatic flash
tooltip.hemomancy.chitinite_set_bonus: Set Bonus (4): Ferric bastion. +2 Armor Toughness, 25% projectile reduction
tooltip.hemomancy.covenant_mantle: One-off chestpiece: spends blood to brace nearby initiated allies. Breaks full set bonuses.
tooltip.hemomancy.hemorath_rib_bonus: Artifact: living marrow slowly refills the vessel over time
tooltip.hemomancy.marionette_crossbar.co: Tap use to call or recall. Hold use for commands. Attack a target to focus this Crossbar's bodies.
tooltip.hemomancy.marionette_crossbar.un: Unattuned: take it to a Puppeteer's Spindle.
tooltip.hemomancy.morphling.bond_ready: Blood bond complete. Ready for incubation
tooltip.hemomancy.prismatic_set_bonus: Set Bonus (4): Prismatic flash. On hit, speed away and disorient nearby hostiles
tooltip.hemomancy.scar_pattern.blank: Blank motif: attune it at a Mason's Effigy.
tooltip.hemomancy.silent_archon_incorpor: Full set: physical attacks pass through you; mundane physical attacks you make deal no damage.
tooltip.hemomancy.silent_archon_set_bonu: Full set: refuse lethal damage once per long cooldown by spending a great volume of blood. Requires the Silent Archon choice and fails for Apotheos.
tooltip.hemomancy.silent_archon_slipping: Double-tap jump: Silent Slipping briefly phases through blocks and grants short, slow flight.
tooltip.hemomancy.unstained_set_bonus: Set Bonus (4): Immunity to Blood Loss and Hemolysis
tooltip.hemomancy.venous_strider_sabaton: One-off boots: reduce projectile and fall damage, with a brief slow-fall brace on long drops. Breaks full set bonuses.
tooltip.hemomancy.vestment_of_the_final_: Pinnacle Unstained chestpiece: awarded at full Enlightenment and counts as Unstained armor.
unstained.hemomancy.clarity.awakened.des: The mind stirs, free from blood-haze.
True enlightenment. The Unstained path is fulfilled.
unstained.hemomancy.clarity.resolute.des: An unbreakable will shields against corruption.
unstained.hemomancy.purity.absolved.desc: Most traces of hemomancy have been cleansed.
unstained.hemomancy.purity.cleansing.des: A steady purification burns away corruption.
unstained.hemomancy.purity.corrupted.des: Blood still courses with hemomantic taint.
unstained.hemomancy.purity.purified.desc: The blood runs silver. It is fully purified.
unstained.hemomancy.purity.tainted.desc: The first impurities begin to recede.
message.hemomancy.warp_chair.bound: The chair remembers you. A counterpart takes root beside the Arbor.
message.hemomancy.warp_chair.degree: The Somnolent Seat will not answer before Initiatory Degree 3.
message.hemomancy.warp_chair.only_paired: Only the chair paired beside your Arbor can carry you home.
message.hemomancy.chamber_visit.warning: The Chamber will release you in %s seconds.
message.hemomancy.chamber_visit.rite_deg: The Chamber Cardinal Rite requires Initiatory Degree 6.
message.hemomancy.chamber_visit.no_ordea: An ordeal cannot begin during a protected visitation.
hemomancy.dialogue.mnemonist.option.ask_: Why do I dream of a chamber?
hemomancy.mnemonist.chamber.guided.first: You may not remember entering it before. I can take you to the Chamber long enough to look around with your eyes open.
hemomancy.mnemonist.chamber.guided.famil: You have already found the Chamber. Come back with me once, deliberately, and look at what you missed in the dream.
hemomancy.mnemonist.chamber.guided.rules: This glimpse lasts two minutes. You can tend the Arbor and rearrange temporary item copies, but cannot drop items, build, or begin an ordeal. Your original inventory and equipment return as they were. Coming home completes this lesson; it does not attune you to the later rite.
hemomancy.mnemonist.chamber.guided.start: The Mnemonist leads you into the Chamber.
hemomancy.mnemonist.chamber.guided.unava: The guided visit cannot begin now. Finish any item transfer, then return with active blood and no other visit or projection underway.
hemomancy.mnemonist.chamber.line1: That is your Chamber of Will. In the first Degrees, ordinary sleep may let you glimpse it for only a minute or two.
hemomancy.mnemonist.chamber.line2: You may walk and tend the Arbor there. Objects and changes stay in the Chamber when you wake.
hemomancy.mnemonist.chamber.line3: At the Third Degree, build a Somnolent Seat. It gives deliberate, longer visits and lets the Chamber keep what you build.
hemomancy.mnemonist.chamber.seat.control: Outside the Chamber, sneak-use your Somnolent Seat to enter directly, or sleep in it through a normal rest to enter on waking. Use only the paired Seat beside your Arbor to begin the trip home.
hemomancy.mnemonist.chamber.seat.duratio: An un-attuned Seat gives five minutes at Degree 3, ten at Degree 4, and twenty from Degree 5. The return is timed, whether you entered directly or slept first.
hemomancy.mnemonist.chamber.support: Your longer visits give you time to work. A Mnemonist serving your bloodline can help you prepare and interpret them, but their presence is not a gate to the Seat or the later rite.
hemomancy.mnemonist.chamber.rite: The Degree-6 Rite of the Chamber of Will is how you attune yourself. Neither an early dream, a guided glimpse, nor a Seat visit grants that permanent right; the rite does not need me to stand beside you.
tooltip.hemomancy.tincture_sanguine_fist: Teaches the arms to answer violence with blood.
tooltip.hemomancy.tincture_laboring_arms: Teaches the arms to remember difficult work.
tooltip.hemomancy.tincture_coursing_legs: Teaches the legs to preserve a runner's cadence.
tooltip.hemomancy.tincture_hushed_gait: Teaches the legs to cross darkness without reporting it.
tooltip.hemomancy.tincture_predatory_eye: Teaches the eyes to find movement in the dark.
tooltip.hemomancy.tincture_second_pulse: Teaches the heart to answer a mortal shock twice.
tooltip.hemomancy.tincture_enduring_visc: Teaches the body to reclaim what exhaustion consumes.
tooltip.hemomancy.tincture_carrion_metab: Teaches the body to take nourishment from corruption.
screen.hemomancy.harbinger_assignment_le: Learn all eight body-bound memories through their tinctures.
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.acce: Show me how blood changes the body.
hemomancy.alchemist.body_answers.line1: You have separated blood by tendency. Now stop treating those answers as ingredients alone.
hemomancy.alchemist.body_answers.line2: Put Sanguine Formation in the Alembic and Fervent Enzyme in the catalyst slot. Empty the supplied Bloody Flask into the tank through the lower-right container input, then move the returned clay flask from the output back into that input. Brewing consumes 2,500 mL from the tank and uses the empty flask for the tincture. Projection can supply the tank too.
hemomancy.alchemist.body_answers.line3: Drink what comes out. Your arms will learn the Thelemic Memory Sanguine Fists and store a reserve of the preparation. Select it through the same radial as Noetic Memories, then activate it. The lesson remains, but every answer costs blood and strains its vessels.
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.musc: What else can the body learn?
hemomancy.alchemist.muscle_memory_catalo: Seven preparations remain. Use Sanguine Formation, blood stored in the Alembic, and an empty clay flask or jug in its container input. Align the catalyst with the tendency you want the body to remember.
Ferric teaches labor, Neurotic teaches motion, Umbral teaches silence, Incandescent teaches sight, Vivacious teaches the heart, Frigid teaches endurance, and Ruinous teaches carrion.
A compatible Morphling makes the answer cheaper and gentler. Certain strains add their own reflex, but none of these lessons bind your final path.
screen.hemomancy.harbinger_assignment_le: Return after First Separation and ask how blood can teach the body directly.
Distil Sanguine Formation with Fervent Enzyme, 2,500 mL stored in the Alembic, and an empty clay flask in its container input. Drink the tincture.
message.hemomancy.mnemonic_reliquary.ref: Your memorized powers now fill every available slot. The Alchemist directs you to the Mnemonist for a more deliberate way to arrange them.
message.hemomancy.mnemonic_reliquary.tau: The Mnemonist teaches you the Mnemonic Reliquary, a Third Degree structure for arranging Thelemic and Noetic Memories together.
hemomancy.dialogue.mnemonist.option.reli: Show me how to weave the Reliquary.
message.hemomancy.muscle_memory.activati: That bodily instruction cannot answer: check its reserve, blood system, and vascular section.
message.hemomancy.muscle_memory.overexer: Overexertion armed. The next valid response will force the memory beyond its safe rhythm.
The body cannot pay the enhanced cost; the memory falls back to its ordinary response.
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.conductive_: Your Ductilis record predicts a conductive response. The Mnemonist calls it a Noetic Memory. The Loom formula is now recorded.
hemomancy.dialogue.mnemonist.conductive_: Your first weave reveals the conductive pattern the Alchemist measured in Ductilis tissue. One Noetic Memory. Two routes to recognition.
hemomancy.dialogue.mnemonist.option.morp: Why is my Morphling worrying the puppet threads?
hemomancy.mnemonist.morphling_puppet_int: The incorporated organism feels projected will as foreign tension. It worries at that tension as if it were edible tissue.
The puppet's imposed will answers in turn. Its repeated intent scatters the organism's attention and frustrates its feeding rhythm.
Neither practice excludes the other. You may sustain both, but the divided strain makes each less efficient.
advancements.hemomancy.vein_mason_d5_rea: The vessel has been strained, diagnosed, treated, and fortified.
advancements.hemomancy.vein_mason_d6_rea: The changed scar route has borne a second Noetic Memory.
hemomancy.anchorite.d5.cause_strain: Use a Thelemic Memory until one section becomes Varicose. I need the body's instruction to make the injury, not steel and not projected will.
hemomancy.anchorite.d5.return_diagnosis: The current catches. Let me read where it catches, then we will choose medicine by the damage rather than habit.
hemomancy.anchorite.d5.recover: The Alchemist's Salve handles one failing course. The Poultice spreads across two. Clotting or widespread Varicosity calls for Vascular Mending.
hemomancy.anchorite.d5.fortify: Medicine restores what was spent. Hematic Fortification permanently reduces vascular strain by 15%. Complete that Fourth Degree rite, then return; it does not erase your earned diagnosis or treatment.
hemomancy.anchorite.d5.complete: The vessel now knows injury, repair, and preparation. Take the deeper pattern.
hemomancy.anchorite.d6.referral: A scar can route an instruction, but I do not author the instruction. Carry my question to a Mnemonist.
hemomancy.anchorite.d6.seek_counsel: The Mnemonist interprets the memory. I determine how the body bears it. Return to their discipline first.
hemomancy.anchorite.d6.first_route: Keep a cerebral scar aligned to a Noetic Memory's primary tendency, then cast it. Mechanical projections do not count.
hemomancy.anchorite.d6.change_loadout: Prepare another arrangement at the Mason's Effigy and burn it. The active scar set must actually change.
hemomancy.anchorite.d6.second_route: Now make the changed architecture bear another matching Noetic Memory.
hemomancy.anchorite.d6.complete: The current changed because you changed its banks. The final pattern is ready.
hemomancy.dialogue.anchorite.option.acce: I will take the question to a Mnemonist.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.anchorite_d5_re: The Anchorite supplies a tier-two pattern, Blank Scar, catalyst, and four Runic Motifs.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.anchorite_d6_re: The Anchorite supplies a tier-three pattern, Blank Scar, catalyst, and eight Runic Motifs. Deep Inscription is still required to carve it.
hemomancy.dialogue.mnemonist.option.anch: The Vein-Mason sent me to ask how a scar should bear a memory.
hemomancy.mnemonist.anchorite_counsel.li: I can tell you what the instruction means and which tendency leads it. The Anchorite cares for the tissue that must carry it.
Match an active cerebral scar to the Noetic Memory's primary tendency. Then change the arrangement and prove the new route still bears the instruction.
There is a Harbinger company that works through performance. They call themselves the Circus. Under that pavilion, every body practices something different.
Do not confuse the show with an invitation. The whole troupe can make one intention real between them, and that is where the danger is.
hemomancy.mnemonist.circus.discovered.li: So you found the pavilion. Then you saw it yourself: the acts are the practice. They are not hiding something else behind the show.
Watch who begins an act and who answers. Their manifestations take shape in that exchange.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.mnemonist_circu: The Mnemonist folds a scarlet waybill along a line that tugs toward the nearest Circus.
hemomancy.circus.discovery: The rough pavilion settles into focus. You have found the Circus.
screen.hemomancy.harbinger_assignment_le: Cause Thelemic Varicosity, receive a diagnosis, use Salve or Poultice, and complete Hematic Fortification.
Return to the Anchorite for a tier-two pattern and scar supplies.
Seek Mnemonist counsel, route a matching Noetic Memory, change the Effigy loadout, then route again.
Return to the Anchorite for a tier-three pattern. Deep Inscription is still required.
hemomancy.anchorite.inquiry.gauge.line1: The gauge reports the vessel and leaves the repair to you. Read the number beside the flow state.
hemomancy.anchorite.inquiry.gauge.line2: Hover a section to see which Noetic and Thelemic routes burden it.
hemomancy.anchorite.inquiry.salve.line1: The Alchemist's Salve closes one local failure. It is field medicine, not conditioning.
hemomancy.anchorite.inquiry.salve.line2: Use it when one section falls below Stable.
hemomancy.anchorite.inquiry.poultice.lin: The Poultice distributes repair across the two weakest sections.
When clotting begins, stop improvising and perform Vascular Mending.
hemomancy.anchorite.inquiry.blank_scar.l: A Blank Scar is tissue prepared to receive an authored pattern.
The Artificer reinforces what faces the world. I reinforce what must bear the current within.
hemomancy.anchorite.inquiry.pattern.line: A Scar Pattern carries instruction. Carve it at the station, then arrange learned scars at the Effigy.
Tier-three instruction still requires Deep Inscription.
hemomancy.anchorite.inquiry.blank_memory: The Mnemonist gives this blank vessel meaning. I care where that meaning travels through you.
Instruction and tissue are separate crafts, even when they must agree.
hemomancy.anchorite.inquiry.conductive_m: Conductive Mark is Noetic: projected instruction, led by its primary tendency.
An aligned active cerebral scar lets its vascular route bear less strain.
hemomancy.anchorite.inquiry.effigy.line1: The Effigy prepares a set from scars already burned into memory.
hemomancy.anchorite.inquiry.effigy.line2: Burn the prepared motif at an Iron Brazier to make that set active.
hemomancy.anchorite.inquiry.brazier.line: The Iron Brazier teaches a carved scar or commits an Effigy pattern.

Place one offering with ordinary use. Blood Projection lights the Brazier for 50 mL. Hold Blood Absorption on the lit offering until it dissolves: a carved Scar costs 100 mL to learn; a prepared Pattern costs 50 mL to commit. Sneaking will retrieve an offering, not burn it.
hemomancy.anchorite.inquiry.tier_one.lin: A first pattern deepens one tendency while active and can route a matching Noetic Memory.
Its routing eases strain by five percent. Matching scars share one route. The strongest route governs.
hemomancy.dialogue.anchorite.option.abou: How does your work differ from the Alchemist's?
How does your work differ from the Artificer's?
hemomancy.anchorite.opinion.alchemist.li: The Alchemist restores damaged tissue with Salve and Poultice. That medicine is necessary and immediate.
I alter what the repaired vessel can bear. Recovery and conditioning are adjacent, not interchangeable.
hemomancy.anchorite.opinion.artificer.li: The Artificer shores up what meets the world: plate, weapon, frame, and graft.
I work inward, where scar and vessel decide whether an instruction survives its passage.
hemomancy.dialogue.artificer.option.clai: Issue the material for my recorded lineage.
hemomancy.dialogue.artificer.option.reco: My first lineage was Silent Archon.
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.arti: The Artificer sent me about my first armor answer.
The Artificer sent me for Crimson Lacquer.
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.ask_: Which specimens should I study for this armor?
hemomancy.alchemist.armor_research.barbe: Catalog a Barbed Urchin, a Desiccant, and a Venom Rib Centipede.
Keep the records. Their spines and venom explain the Barbed answer better than another surrendered carcass.
hemomancy.alchemist.armor_research.chiti: Catalog a Chalybeate Snail, a Chitinite, and a Fervent Chitinite.
Keep the records. Their shells show the Artificer where Chitinite armor can yield without breaking.
hemomancy.alchemist.armor_research.prism: Catalog a Prism Cuttle, a Scarlet Serpent, and a Verdigris Moth.
Keep the records. Their changing pigments explain what the Prismatic answer is imitating.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.alchemist_armor: The Alchemist compares your Bestiary notes with the Artificer's work and gives you another matching reagent.
Place a Hematic Armature. Return after the frame has existed in your own workshop.
Use that Armature to complete one Hematic Iron upgrade.
Complete and wear the full Hematic Iron set before the final fitting.
hemomancy.artificer.assignment.three_ans: Make your first Barbed, Chitinite, or Prismatic armor piece. The first family is the answer I will record.
Take my recorded answer to an Alchemist. They can match its reagent and identify useful Bestiary specimens.
Complete and wear the full set from your recorded family.
Prove the set answers in the field: retaliation, projectile reduction, or prismatic flash.
hemomancy.artificer.assignment.crimson_v: Complete the Rite of Armature Consecration.
Carry my inspection to an Alchemist and receive Crimson Lacquer.
Complete the first Blood Lust upgrade.
Complete and wear the full Blood Lust set.
Land a direct hit and make the full vestment draw or bank blood.
hemomancy.artificer.assignment.assumed_l: Complete one Living Weapon Graft rite.
Defeat a hostile with a transformed Living Staff weapon form.
Learn all seven base Living Weapon forms before the final fitting.
hemomancy.artificer.assignment.weight_of: Complete the Rite of the Monolithic Armature.
Complete the first valid D7 armor upgrade. Its lineage will be recorded permanently.
Complete and wear the full set from the recorded D7 lineage.
Successfully activate that lineage's registered armor ability.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.artificer_rewar: That material has not been earned, or was already issued.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.artificer_equip: the full recorded set is equipped
equip the full recorded set first
hemomancy.dialogue.event.artificer_three: Recorded fork: %1$s. %3$s. Take the inspection to an Alchemist; they can compare it with your Bestiary records.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.artificer_crims: The consecrated frame holds. %3$s. Take my referral to an Alchemist.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.artificer_weigh: Recorded D7 lineage: %2$s. %3$s. Its matching material has been issued.
hemomancy.dialogue.event.artificer_d7_re: The material matches the first lineage. Later upgrades will not rewrite it.
advancements.hemomancy.artificer_weight_: Return to the Artificer for the recorded lineage material.
screen.hemomancy.harbinger_assignment_le: Return for inspection and four Hematic Iron Scrap.
Wear the full set and claim its fitting.
Return so the first family can be recorded.
Take the referral to an Alchemist for a reagent and specimen study.
Trigger that set's real defensive response.
Receive Crimson Lacquer from an Alchemist.
Complete and wear the Blood Lust set.
Trigger direct-hit lifesteal or borrowed blood.
Return for the Crimson Vestment Fitting.
Reach Degree 5 and bond a Living Staff.
Receive the Living Weapon graft briefing.
Return for inspection and a Blank Hematic Memory.
Defeat a hostile with a transformed Living Staff.
Learn all seven base weapon forms. %1$s/%2$s
Return for the Assumed Limb Fitting.
Return so its first lineage can be recorded.
Return for the Monolithic Frame Fitting.
hemomancy.manipulation.crimson_coronatio: Prepares up to eight retaliatory blood lances for twenty seconds. Full charge strengthens their damage and lets each pierce an additional target. Cannot be recast while the crown still holds lances.
hemomancy.manipulation.sovereign_instinc: When enabled and struck while at least four blood-bearing enemies target you, turns commandable attackers (80 maximum health or less) on one another for five seconds. Bosses only feel its pressure; larger bodies are unaffected. Requires active blood and Ductilis alignment.
hemomancy.manipulation.synaptic_storm.de: Chains charged electricity between up to eight enemies, prioritizing conductive targets. Paralysis lasts 10-60 ticks; players are capped at 20 ticks and bosses are slowed. Ordinary hops reach five blocks, conductive hops eight.
hemomancy.manipulation.living_circuit.de: Links up to three nearby teammates with travelling nerve impulses, granting speed and haste and arming their next hostile strike with Conductive Mark. Each pulse arcs from every linked body to the nearest visible hostile within four blocks. With no teammate in reach, the circuit runs through you.
hemomancy.manipulation.white_verdict.des: Fires a piercing beam whose reach, width and damage grow with charge, up to 12 damage. Deals 50% more against a previously Illuminated or concealed target, never twice. Consumes existing Illumination.
hemomancy.manipulation.vigil_of_glass.de: Greatly reduces distant projectile harm and exposes its shooter.
hemomancy.manipulation.furnace_veins.des: Channels a close heat field that burns enemies, thaws allies, and grants allies fire resistance.
hemomancy.manipulation.phoenix_debt.desc: When enabled with active blood and sufficient Flammeus alignment, arms a shared Last Rite and pays blood to survive lethal harm and erupt in cleansing flame. It shows ready, and fires, only while you hold enough blood for its price.
hemomancy.manipulation.absolute_stillnes: Channels a freezing field that slows hostile projectiles, smothers fire and drives Rime into nearby enemies. Each pulse freezes the blood of enemies already at three Rime for further damage.
hemomancy.manipulation.rimebound_sentenc: Deals charged frost damage, up to 12 at full charge. Full charge establishes three Rime levels and temporarily encloses the target.
hemomancy.manipulation.hematic_ballast.d: Automatically anchors the body against a powerful launch or knockback.
hemomancy.manipulation.iron_choir.desc: Channels Resistance and three projectile interceptions per paid pulse. Iron plates intercept hostile shots and strike back at their owners, and each pulse looses a blood needle at the nearest visible hostile within ten blocks.
hemomancy.manipulation.funeral_bell.desc: Releases a charged deathly pulse, consuming Necrosis to release its stored damage early. Wither, Poison, Blood Loss, Insatiable Hunger and Grave Debt each deepen the toll; all but Grave Debt are spent. Everything scales with charge: a partial toll releases only that share of the stored Necrosis, and the rest still releases when Necrosis ends.
hemomancy.manipulation.carrion_communion: Drains up to four blood-bearing enemies afflicted by Necrosis, Wither, Poison, Blood Loss, Insatiable Hunger or Grave Debt while channeled, restoring half the health actually drained.
hemomancy.manipulation.penumbral_drift.d: Channels a swift Veil that repeatedly sheds ordinary enemy attention. Bosses retain their target. Attacking ends the drift, but that first blow, melee or otherwise, lands as an ambush for half again its damage and leaves the victim Obscured.
hemomancy.manipulation.eclipse_well.desc: Creates a charged well of darkness that pulls enemies inward, keeps them Obscured and bites the Obscured each second. A fully charged well collapses as it ends, flinging non-boss enemies at its heart elsewhere, as a chorus fruit would.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_anvil: The Anvil fixes iron into the blood, the joints, and finally the earth beneath them. The practitioner becomes nearly immovable, and every step carries that same weight.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_blight: The Blight turns the practitioner's own toxins outward. The body learns to treat poison as a weapon, though the same venom can still read its bearer as the wound.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_blood_h: The Blood-Honed Scar lets an enchanted edge draw strength from the blood behind it. The deeper the weapon's enchantment bites, the more blood the strike spends.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_chimera: Two bodies move through one vessel. The Chimera quickens the strike, the step, and the heartbeat until armor becomes dead weight and the body starts feeding the pace.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_corona: The Corona drives Flammeus discipline to its final stage. Every strike burns hotter, the body stands firm against impact, and armor blisters away while the veins keep feeding the heat.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_crucibl: The Crucible demands motion and returns iron. Blood settles into armor, toughness, and a deeper Iron Heart, leaving the practitioner built like a wall and forced to move like one.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_descend: The Descendence aligns blood with the deep cold. The practitioner crosses frozen ground with extraordinary speed, but the cold reaches the hands and drains force from every slower strike.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_eye: The Eye carves sight directly into the hemomantic lattice. Darkness opens around the practitioner while each moment of that vision drains blood and each quick step leaves less force behind the blow.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_feral: The Feral reaches beneath doctrine for the hunger that came before it. The hand strikes faster, but the skin gives up some of the armor it once carried.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_flux: The Flux keeps blood from settling into one shape. Strikes arrive faster as armor loosens around the changing form, so every gain in speed leaves the vessel easier to open.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_glacier: The Glacier slows the hands so the rest of the body can move with cold precision. The practitioner gains speed across the field, but every strike must drag itself through the frost first.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_halo: The Halo follows those who learned to endure. It hardens the body against heavy blows, then makes every step feel the weight of that protection.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_heart: The first scar is also the most honest. The Heart gives the vessel more life by narrowing the blood it can hold, so survival grows while the power available to spend grows smaller.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_marrow: The Marrow reaches past blood and into the reserve buried in bone. The vessel gains more life, then pays for that depth with a smaller blood pool and a heavier step.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_moon: The Moon aligns blood with a rhythm the practitioner cannot command. The shadow carries the body faster while each blow lands with less force, an ebb and flow written into motion.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_oblivio: The Oblivion strips away whatever a vessel can spare. Its bearer strikes harder while health and blood drain with the same steady appetite.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_phoenix: The Phoenix pours vitality back into a vessel prepared to burn for it. More life survives inside the body, but the blood pool closes tight and every step slows under the cost of carrying it.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_pyre: The Pyre sharpens the strike by feeding protection into it. The practitioner hits harder because the body has given the blade one less layer to cross.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_rime: The Rime sends cold into the legs before it reaches the hands. Movement quickens across the frozen field, then each strike loses time to the ice gathering in the wrists.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_shade: The Shade lets the practitioner move through darkness with the speed of a passing thought. The body arrives quickly, but the strike behind it lands with less force.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_sol: The Sol teaches blood to answer heat before the mind can. The strike grows sharper as the guard burns away, leaving the practitioner bright, fast to wound, and easier to wound in return.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_thorn: Every wound teaches something. The Thorn returns that lesson through tougher armor and a deeper Iron Heart, while the iron added to the blood weighs down the legs.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_transce: The Transcendence burns through the limits carried in a practitioner's blood. What remains is harder to break, slower to move, and forced to survive on a thinner blood reserve.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_veil: The Veil hides its bearer in plain light. That radiance hardens the body against heavy blows, but it gathers around every movement until speed gives way beneath it.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.scar_wither: The Wither pulls vital excess from its target and puts that force behind the practitioner's strike. The vessel gives up part of its own health to keep making the claim.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.rhizovitta_c: Rhizovitta Communis roots the vessel into the fungal floor and lets the surrounding mycelium answer blood spent in motion. It feels like buried veins feeding the body from below.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.talaromyces_: Talaromyces Minus is a quiet decomposer of dead matter. Once etched into the hemomantic lattice, it leads the hand along ferric seams as if stone were only the next thing waiting to be broken down.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.oculiflora_r: Oculiflora Reticularis opens in darkness like an eye grown from hyphae. It catches nearby signals and passes them into forms the wearer's blood can understand.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.noctifly_aga: The Noctifly Agaric unfurls pale mycelial wings when the wearer wills it. The fungus carries the practitioner into a hover, closer to being lifted than learning to fly.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.putrivora_re: Putrivora Resolvens knows the taste of poison, wither, hunger, and blood loss. It shortens each affliction's meal, then returns what little nourishment the suffering contained.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.cryostroma_p: Cryostroma Perdurans forms a cold skin over living mycelium. Motion and casting crack the frost, while stillness conserves blood and gives damaged vascular paths time to close.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.antiphonomyc: Antiphonomyces Resonans answers impact with a counter-song. Violence enters the body, and the scar teaches the vessel how to echo that force in useful directions.
screen.hemomancy.scars.lore.saprovitta_v: Saprovitta Vestigium leaves a feeding wake behind the moving practitioner. Anyone who follows steps into hungry blood-fungus and meets the garden's appetite firsthand.
hemomancy.dialogue.circus_performer.welc: Stand there. Let every eye find you. Strangers fare better here once the whole pavilion is looking at the same person.
hemomancy.dialogue.circus_fire_eater.lin: You do not swallow the fire. You teach your body which burns to keep and which to breathe back out.
The torch is just a staff-form. We make the breath carry farther.
The crowd holds the shape for me. Without them, I would only burn my throat.
hemomancy.dialogue.circus_stilt_walker.l: Up here, I decide where the crowd looks for danger.
These are braces, not legs. Watch the cords, not my feet.
Once every eye comes up to meet me, somebody else owns the floor.
hemomancy.dialogue.circus_acrobat.line1: By the time you understand where I landed, I have already left it.
hemomancy.dialogue.circus_acrobat.line2: I never vanish. You just choose the landing too soon.
hemomancy.dialogue.circus_acrobat.line3: The Mummer takes your eye. I take the moment after you turn it.
A blade tells the truth. The hand telling you where it will land does not.
The knives fly straight. People are what bend.
Nine marks teach distance. The tenth teaches when not to throw.
hemomancy.summon.ringmaster_pattern.lore: A captured office in a low-damage body. Its gestures relay one owner's nearby commands without multiplying them.
message.hemomancy.thread_ripper.charge: The tether needs a full moment of tension before it can be cut.
message.hemomancy.thread_ripper.no_tethe: Thread Ripper finds no hostile tether it is permitted to sever.
hemomancy.manipulation.thread_ripper.des: Fully charge to cut an aimed tether: frees a Circus captive, unravels a weakened hostile puppet, or wounds and silences a healthier one. It also unravels a Vex, or a summoned or bound creature owned by someone you may harm, at any health; an unravelled Drudge drops its Blood Memory. Tamed animals, mounts and bosses are spared.
hemomancy.circus.captive.severed: The thread snaps. Captive %s dies with it, and the anchor beneath the horse is exposed.
hemomancy.circus.ringmaster.silent: The figure in the rafters looks through you. It will not take shape for you yet.
hemomancy.circus.ringmaster.line.neutral: Now you understand the bargain. Take my place, cut the others free, or walk away.
hemomancy.circus.ringmaster.line.success: Learn every act. Hold every eye in the pavilion. Then come take this hat and the office bound to it.
hemomancy.circus.ringmaster.line.liberat: Three failed initiates ride that carousel. Cut their threads and their bodies will die. The anchors beneath them will not. Break those too.
hemomancy.circus.ringmaster.line.success: The pavilion knows its successor. It answers to you now.
hemomancy.circus.ringmaster.line.liberat: Only the ruin answers you now.
hemomancy.circus.ringmaster.warning.succ: Choose Succession and the pavilion stays standing, but its trials bind to you. You get one chance to change this choice before either ending is complete.
hemomancy.circus.ringmaster.warning.libe: Choose Liberation and the three bound initiates die when you sever their threads. Then you destroy the carousel and leave the pavilion in ruins. You get one chance to change this choice before either ending is complete.
hemomancy.circus.option.reject: No. I will break the carousel and free its captives.
hemomancy.circus.option.confirm_successi: I understand. Bind me to Succession.
hemomancy.circus.option.confirm_liberati: I understand what it costs. I will end the pavilion.
hemomancy.circus.option.repair: I chose wrong. Let me use my one chance to change it.
hemomancy.circus.finale.not_ready: You are not ready for Succession. Finish every controlled act and complete your attunement.
hemomancy.circus.finale.claimed: Another performer has already claimed this pavilion. It will not answer you.
hemomancy.circus.finale.complete.success: The Ringmaster yields without dying. His office becomes a pattern, and the pavilion remains standing.
hemomancy.circus.finale.complete.liberat: The Ringmaster falls. The three captives and their anchors are gone, and the carousel is ruined for good.
hemomancy.circus.challenge.begin.0: Keep the trained peacock spider in sight until its dance ends. It will not attack you.
hemomancy.circus.challenge.begin.2: Stay inside the ring and withstand the dolls until the act ends.
hemomancy.circus.challenge.begin.3: Watch the Knife Thrower. The blade flies straight. The setup does not.
hemomancy.circus.challenge.begin.4: Stay in the ring until the troupe finishes the carousel pattern.
hemomancy.circus.challenge.hold.0: The spider is still dancing. Keep your eyes on it.
hemomancy.circus.challenge.hold.2: The dolls are committed. Hold your ground.
hemomancy.circus.challenge.hold.3: You found the thrower's rhythm. Do not lose it.
hemomancy.circus.challenge.hold.4: The troupe is halfway through the pattern. Stay in the ring.
hemomancy.circus.challenge.complete.0: You kept the spider in sight until the dance ended.
hemomancy.circus.challenge.complete.2: You held the ring until the dolls stopped.
hemomancy.circus.challenge.complete.3: You read the Knife Thrower's rhythm and survived the act.
hemomancy.circus.challenge.complete.4: You held the ring until the carousel pattern ended.
hemomancy.circus.challenge.failed: The act is over. Speak to the Ringmaster when you are ready to try again.
hemomancy.manipulation.ferric_rampart.de: Raises a rigid five-block-wide, three-block-high iron wall for ten seconds. Blocks bodies; your own and your allies' projectiles pass through, while all others are destroyed. Requires clear, supported ground. Magnetism family level 1.
hemomancy.manipulation.ferric_spikes.des: Raises five blood-iron blades for six seconds. Obstructs movement and deals 3.5 Ferric damage on contact, scaled by Crimson Mastery and applying Lodestone, at most once every ten ticks per enemy. Requires supported ground. Magnetism family level 2.
hemomancy.mnemonist.item_inquiry.memory_: Ferric Rampart. Blood gathers into overlapping iron plates.
Learn its memory after the first level of Sanguine Magnetism. The wall needs firm ground and room to stand.
Ferric Spikes. Rusted blades rise from a line of blood.
The second level of Sanguine Magnetism steadies their shape. Ductilis can carry a current through summoned iron.
hemomancy.dialogue.reward_not_delivered: No reward was delivered. Check the requirements or reopen the conversation near the speaker.
hemomancy.tutorial.current_controls: Hold a sword and press %s for Blood Formation. Aim at a completed bloodcraft pattern and press %s to activate it. Cycle equipped manipulations with %s.
hemomancy.tutorial.sample_controls: Loose vials take a sample with Attack (%s). The Living Syringe uses Use Item (%s).
hemomancy.tutorial.starter_blood: Your initiation provides four Bloody Flasks, once only. Drink one to conjure Blood Absorption and Blood Projection. The next two can fill your vessel; keep the fourth for recovery. Drinking raises casting costs temporarily. Visit the Vicar for first bloodcraft. For repeatable blood, spin animal samples in opposing Vial Centrifuge slots, then reclaim its reservoir with Blood Absorption. Each completed batch yields 250 ml; more samples yield more enzymes.
screen.hemomancy.puppeteers_spindle.reca: Recall dismisses the body. Calling again pays the call cost for full health.
screen.hemomancy.puppeteers_spindle.ring: Call a partner body: the Conductor supports other puppets.
screen.hemomancy.puppeteers_spindle.mnem: Mark a target, then attack it: the Mnemonist echoes recorded hits.
hemomancy.anchorite.d5.activation: Distill and drink a Thelemic dose, equip its memory, select it, then press your manipulation-use key to enable it. Its ordinary bodily action spends blood and reserve. Crouch and press that key to arm the next response for overexertion: twice the blood and two-and-a-half times the strain.
hemomancy.anchorite.d5.stop: Watch the named body section in Vascular Status. Stop when it first becomes Varicose, below 50 health: press the use key again without crouching to disable the memory. Bring Salve before training and return for diagnosis before treatment. Passive recovery can change the medicine you need; your earned lesson progress remains.
screen.hemomancy.book_of_observances.obs: Novitiate work is available only before purification, baseline restoration, or Clarity.
Before purification: claim Gather Remedies from the Acolyte first.
Before purification: claim Gentle Separation from the Acolyte first.
Before purification: claim Stillwater Labor from the Zealot first.
Before purification: claim Clean Labor from the Zealot first.
effect.hemomancy.sanguine_pressure.desc: Up to 3 pressure levels. Rupture deals 2 extra damage per level.
effect.hemomancy.sanguine_pressure.count: Rupture consumes pressure. Bloodless targets cannot build it.
effect.hemomancy.necrosis.desc: Healing received -25%. Banks 25% of direct health damage, up to 6.
effect.hemomancy.necrosis.counter: Cleansing removes debt safely; natural expiry releases it.
effect.hemomancy.lodestone.desc: Ferric knockback +25%. Owned magnetic fields pull 50% harder.
effect.hemomancy.lodestone.counter: Also conducts electricity. Cleansing removes the iron signature.
effect.hemomancy.searing.desc: Crimson heat deals 1 damage per second. Refresh adds no extra streams.
effect.hemomancy.searing.counter: Water, Fire Resistance or cold extinguish it. Combustion spends heat.
effect.hemomancy.rime.desc: Movement -15% per level, up to -45%. Actions remain available.
effect.hemomancy.rime.counter: Heat melts one level. Ferric shatters level 3 for 4 extra damage.
effect.hemomancy.disrupted.desc: Attacks, item use and casting interrupted for half a second.
effect.hemomancy.disrupted.counter: Movement remains available. Bosses resist interruption.
effect.hemomancy.illuminated.desc: Exposed through school concealment. Enables Lux follow-ups.
effect.hemomancy.illuminated.counter: Reproof and White Verdict consume exposure. Glowing cannot replace it.
effect.hemomancy.obscured.desc: Reliable perception is limited to 4 blocks. No action or movement penalty.
effect.hemomancy.obscured.counter: Close enemies and Illuminated targets remain perceivable.
effect.hemomancy.veiled.desc: School concealment hides the caster. Close enemies can still defend.
effect.hemomancy.veiled.counter: Attacking breaks concealment. Illumination suppresses it temporarily.
hemomancy.manipulation.sanguine_marionet: Channel a mobile blood tether for up to 8 seconds. Aim at an enemy to attack or reachable ground to move. One blood-bearing mob, at most 80 maximum health; 8-block acquisition and 16-block tether. A Blood-Bound creature is released from its binding and taken. Hematic Rebuke family level 2. Base cost: 50 mL per second.
hemomancy.manipulation.hematic_flare.des: Strikes the creature you aim at with a short Lux ray and Illuminates it, exposing concealment and preparing Lux follow-ups. Fails without a visible target.
death.attack.vesper_rend: %1$s was raked open from beneath the floor
death.attack.vesper_rend.player: %1$s was raked open from beneath the floor by %2$s
death.attack.vesper_impale: %1$s was impaled on a Refusal's sting
death.attack.endless_hour_debt: %1$s was collected by the Endless Hour
death.attack.endless_hour_debt.player: %1$s was collected by the Endless Hour while fighting %2$s
message.hemomancy.recall_barb_escape: Hold Sneak to tear the Recall Barb free.
item.hemomancy.bloody_vial.unreadable: Unreadable specimen; its contents are preserved.
item.hemomancy.bloody_vial.examine: Examine with a Hematic Microscope to reveal its responses.
item.hemomancy.bloody_vial.saturation: Transfusion Saturation: 20 s before another injection.
item.hemomancy.bloody_vial.inject: Hold use for 0.8 s to inject. The empty vial is retained.
message.hemomancy.blood_injection.no_res: This blood carries no usable response.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.blood_v: A loose sample can also be injected: hold use until the glass empties. Its response is brief, and your circulation needs twenty seconds to settle. Unknown blood still works; examination tells you what to expect. The rack only carries samples.
message.hemomancy.cabinet.remove_specime: The specimens must be removed before the cabinet can be dismantled.
tooltip.hemomancy.cabinet.capacity: Nine pigeonholes, 64 identical full vials each.
tooltip.hemomancy.cabinet.creative: Creative destruction discards all stored specimens.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.cabinet: Nine pigeonholes, sixty-four full vials apiece. The cabinet keeps an exemplar on display; the rest stay safely behind it. Loose vials still travel one at a time.
Each pigeonhole accepts only an exact match, including its name and identification. Examined and unknown samples belong apart. Shift-click to deposit or withdraw as many individual vials as fit.

Fit a clear glass pane to see the collection with the door shut. Sneak-use a Knapper to remove it; in survival the pane is returned. Creative fitting costs nothing and removal returns nothing. The Knapper takes no wear.

Empty the cabinet before dismantling it. It cannot be pushed, and ordinary explosions leave a filled cabinet intact. Deliberate creative destruction discards the contents. A carried cabinet never stores specimens.
gui.hemomancy.clairaudiograph.no_calls: No catalogued calls. Insert a supported creature sample.
gui.hemomancy.clairaudiograph.missing_au: This voice has no audio in your resource packs.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.clairau: The blood is identifiable, yet the auditory pattern survives ordinary analysis. After examining three creature sources, ask me about Beyond Ordinary Analysis and take the question to the Mnemonist.
The Mnemonist teaches the Clairaudiograph after your clinical observations and referral.
The Mnemonist teaches the Clairaudiograph after your clinical observations and referral.
The Mnemonist teaches the Clairaudiograph after your clinical observations and referral.
message.hemomancy.field_case.busy: Close the case and let the lid settle before picking it up.
tooltip.hemomancy.field_case.place: Place to open. Manual specimen access only.
tooltip.hemomancy.field_case.pickup: Sneak-use with an empty hand when closed to pack. Breaking returns the filled case.
tooltip.hemomancy.field_case.invalid: Unreadable contents. Placement refused; data retained.
hemomancy.alchemist.item_inquiry.field_c: The cabinet stays in the laboratory; the Field Case carries nine distinct specimens, sixteen identical vials of each. Names, source and identification must match exactly. A full specimen cannot claim another compartment.
Set it down to unlatch it and use the specimen cells. It cannot be opened in your pocket or fed by hoppers. Once everyone has finished and the lid has settled, sneak-use an empty hand to pack it.

Breaking closes the viewers and returns one filled case, never a shower of loose vials. Creative placement moves filled contents too. Rebuild a cabinet with six pieces of leather and two Hematic Iron Scraps to make one.
hemomancy.succession.dismiss_confirm: Permanently release %s from this bloodline? Their former bloodline will no longer be able to restore them.
hemomancy.succession.recovery_hint: Recover lost remnants at your fane bloodwell.
hemomancy.succession.ask_bequest: Will you bequeath your profession to our bloodline?
hemomancy.succession.donate: Donate a blood sample to our bloodline.
hemomancy.succession.accept_bequest: We accept your freely given Bequest.
hemomancy.succession.consent: I remain here, as teacher and witness. I freely pledge my professional blood-memory to your bloodline. Those you awaken will be new people, carrying my vocation and making histories of their own.
hemomancy.succession.bequest_granted: %s has granted your bloodline a Mnemonic Bequest.
hemomancy.succession.empty_vial: Hold an empty blood vial to receive a donation.
hemomancy.succession.donated: %s has donated an identity-bearing blood sample.
hemomancy.succession.self_blood_cost: Drawing your own sample requires 100 mL of personal blood.
hemomancy.succession.unavailable: My memory remains, but I cannot work here for you. I need my bloodline and an unclaimed workplace inside its fane.
hemomancy.succession.rejection: The memories refuse these identities. A Misbegotten vessel awakens.
hemomancy.succession.remnant.bound: Bound to its original bloodline. Copies become inert after restoration or reissue.
hemomancy.succession.phase.1: Identity: two bloods find their places.
hemomancy.succession.phase.2: Life: a heart begins to beat.
hemomancy.succession.phase.4: Recognition: the memories examine their host.
hemomancy.succession.failure.eligibility: A D5 bloodline member must officiate inside their registered fane.
hemomancy.succession.failure.offerings: Use the marked brazier order: donor or remnant, officiant blood, then Ambergris for a new incarnation.
hemomancy.succession.failure.legacy_samp: This sample has no individual identity. Draw a new sample before beginning.
hemomancy.succession.failure.remnant: This remnant is inert, already restored, or belongs to another bloodline.
hemomancy.succession.failure.profession: The donated sample must identify one of the five professional vocations.
hemomancy.succession.failure.body: Place a Vacant Effigy on the adjacent Venous Stone plinth.
hemomancy.succession.failure.reserved: Another rite has already reserved this body, identity, or workplace.
hemomancy.succession.failure.workplace: No loaded, unclaimed workplace of this profession exists inside the fane.
hemomancy.succession.failure.interrupted: The succession rite has lost its floor or body. Consumed offerings cannot be recovered.
hemomancy.succession.teaching.alchemist: Life is not memory. Seat Sanguine Quintessence in the Focus; put the consenting donor vial first, your own vial second, and Ambergris third. Sneak-use an empty vial to draw 100 mL of your own blood. An Alembic or Centrifuge gives my successors a workplace.
hemomancy.succession.teaching.mnemonist: A Bequest is permission, never possession. Death leaves a Bound Mnemonic Remnant. Restore it with an Effigy, Quintessence, your own blood, and a free workplace. No new Ambergris is needed. A lost remnant can be recovered at the fane bloodwell; old copies then become inert.
hemomancy.succession.teaching.artificer: At D5, raise a Vacant Effigy's frame beside a Cardinal Focus on a Greater Working floor: Venous Stone center, Hematic Iron on its four edges, Conscious Mass at its four corners. Seat a Sanguine Formation, set an Armor Stand and Blood Stained Stone in lit braziers, and feed it 250 mL. Carry the effigy to a Venous Stone plinth beside the Cardinal Focus on a Greater Dominion floor.
hemomancy.succession.teaching.cicatrix_a: An inherited vocation needs somewhere to take root. Build a Mason's Effigy or Fungal Implantation Pylon within the fane. One station supports one successor; if it is lost, their professional work must pause.
hemomancy.succession.teaching.vicar: The rite belongs to the bloodline, not the hand that begins it. Any D5 member may officiate. Originals remain at their outposts; successors serve as local teachers and rite helpers. False identity becomes a Misbegotten vessel when memory descends.
hemomancy.succession.greeting.0.first: A new voice. Sit with me; there is much I know and much I have yet to learn.
hemomancy.succession.greeting.0.return: I remember your voice. Where did we leave our work?
hemomancy.succession.greeting.1.first: You have found my station. Tell me what needs doing.
hemomancy.succession.greeting.1.return: Back to work, then. Show me what changed.
hemomancy.succession.greeting.2.first: I woke carrying old knowledge. I would like to put it to use.
hemomancy.succession.greeting.2.return: It is good to see a familiar face among these borrowed memories.
hemomancy.succession.fracture.alchemist: [Fractured voice] The mixture... your name... not mine...
hemomancy.succession.fracture.mnemonist: [Fractured voice] I remember you remembering me.
hemomancy.succession.fracture.artificer: [Fractured voice] The hand does not fit the work.
hemomancy.succession.fracture.cicatrix_a: [Fractured voice] A scar with no wound. A wound with your face.
hemomancy.succession.fracture.vicar: [Fractured voice] The blood knows whose vow was broken.
hemomancy.succession.failure.cap: The server's successor population limit has been reached.
hemomancy.succession.sample_bound: Donated to one bloodline under a Mnemonic Bequest.
hemomancy.succession.personal_identity: I carry a teacher's craft, but the life I am making here is my own.
hemomancy.succession.rite_hint: Remain in the circle. Hold the normal rite cancellation control to stop.
hemomancy.succession.jei.create: Braziers: 1 donor blood, 2 your blood, 3 Ambergris. Use the marked sockets beside the effigy.
hemomancy.succession.jei.restore: Braziers: 1 bound remnant, 2 your blood. The third socket stays empty.
hemomancy.succession.jei.requirements: D5 · Greater Dominion floor · fane workplace · 60 seconds
hemomancy.clinical.microscope.title: Hematic Microscopy
hemomancy.clinical.microscope.lesson: Hold that filled creature vial where I can see it. Blood differs in more than quantity. I have written the Hematic Microscope recipe into your notes. Hold the microscope in your main hand and one filled vial in your offhand, then hold Use for two seconds. Observe the tendencies and biological properties before deciding what to do with them. Return after a successful examination.
hemomancy.clinical.injection.title: Borrowed Physiology
hemomancy.clinical.injection.lesson: You have seen what the specimen carries. Now you may borrow its physiology: hold Use with a filled creature Blood Vial for 0.8 seconds to inject it. The blood is consumed; the empty vessel remains. Read the identified response first. Benefits are temporary, drawbacks may accompany them, and Transfusion Saturation prevents another injection for twenty seconds. The microscope does not consume your sample.
hemomancy.clinical.cabinet.title: Phlebotomist's Cabinet
hemomancy.clinical.cabinet.lesson: Three distinct sources, properly examined. A specimen without provenance is refuse. A collection without order is merely a cupboard full of coagulation. Your Cabinet recipe is now recorded. Its nine pigeonholes each hold 64 full vials of one component-identical specimen. Source, identification, names, and every other component must match. Click a vial into a cell; click with an empty cursor to withdraw one. Fit a clear glass pane for viewing; sneak-use a Knapper to remove it. Craft a Cabinet, then store and withdraw a sample.
hemomancy.clinical.field_referral.title: A Cabinet for the Road
hemomancy.clinical.field_referral.lesson: You have crafted a Cabinet and used it in both directions. A cabinet serves the laboratory. It does not serve the road. Take your storage practice and Hematic Iron to the Artificer you have met. Ask for a Field Case. I will continue to answer for the specimens; the Artificer will answer for the hinges and catches.
hemomancy.clinical.field_case.title: The Laboratory Abroad
hemomancy.clinical.field_case.lesson: The Alchemist has referred you. Rebuild an empty Phlebotomist's Cabinet with leather and Hematic Iron Scraps; the recipe consumes the Cabinet. Reinforcement, shock-isolated cells, and secure catches preserve its indexing while carried. Place the Field Case before opening it. Its nine cells each hold sixteen matching vials, fewer than the Cabinet. Close every menu and wait for the lid to shut, then sneak-use with an empty hand to recover it. The carried case retains specimen identity and counts.
hemomancy.clinical.echo_referral.title: Beyond Ordinary Analysis
hemomancy.clinical.echo_referral.lesson: I can establish whose blood this is and which properties it bears. The residual auditory pattern is another matter. An Echo Shard suggests a retained expression, not another physiological tendency. Seek the Mnemonist. You have enough observations to ask the question at Degree 2; formal recording instruction begins at Degree 3.
hemomancy.clinical.clairaudiograph.title: What Blood Remembers Saying
hemomancy.clinical.clairaudiograph.lesso: The Alchemist has established the specimen. Listen now to what its former body repeated. I have recorded the Clairaudiograph and Wax Cylinder recipes. Place a filled creature Blood Vial and a blank cylinder into the machine, select a call, and Carve for four seconds. The blood is consumed and its empty vial remains. Preview is private; Play reaches nearby listeners. Carved cylinders retain a creature expression, not an injectable property. Identification is required for your training, but the machine can record unexamined creature blood too.
hemomancy.clinical.next.title: What is my next clinical assignment?
hemomancy.clinical.next.collect: Begin with my First Separation assignment. Use its loose vials to sample living creatures, balance the Centrifuge, and recover the enzyme. Report back for a Living Syringe and an initialized eight-vial rack. Bring me one filled creature vial to discuss observation.
hemomancy.clinical.next.show_vial: Return to the Alchemist holding one filled creature Blood Vial in either hand. The microscope lesson and recipe follow that first specimen.
hemomancy.clinical.next.examine: Craft the Hematic Microscope. Hold it in your main hand and a single filled creature Blood Vial in your offhand. Hold Use for two uninterrupted seconds, then return to the Alchemist.
hemomancy.clinical.next.injection: After successfully examining a creature sample yourself, ask the Alchemist about Borrowed Physiology. That lesson unlocks direct injection.
hemomancy.clinical.next.three_sources: Examine blood from three different creature types with the microscope, then speak to the Alchemist. Repeated vials from the same entity type count only once. Already identified vials still need your own two-second examination.
hemomancy.clinical.next.cabinet: You have identified three distinct sources. Ask the Alchemist for the Phlebotomist's Cabinet lesson and recipe.
hemomancy.clinical.next.storage: Craft a Phlebotomist's Cabinet yourself, insert a full sample through its menu, then withdraw one. Hoppers and Field Cases do not demonstrate your stationary Cabinet practice.
hemomancy.clinical.next.degree_two: After the Vicar grants Degree 2, complete First Separation and an Alembic distillation. Ask the Alchemist for Concentrated Blood, inject it, then sleep to reach Degree 3.
hemomancy.clinical.next.iron_artificer: At Degree 2, obtain Hematic Iron Scraps and meet the Artificer. Return to the Alchemist after crafting, filling, and withdrawing from your Cabinet.
hemomancy.clinical.next.referral: Ask the Alchemist for A Cabinet for the Road, then take the referral to the Artificer.
hemomancy.clinical.next.later_study: The Artificer handles your field conversion. Ask me about Beyond Ordinary Analysis once you have examined three creature sources; formal mnemonic recording is the Mnemonist's work.
hemomancy.clinical.next.field_referral: The Alchemist must refer you first. At Degree 2, craft a Cabinet, personally insert and withdraw a sample, obtain Hematic Iron Scraps, and meet me. Return to the Alchemist for the handoff.
hemomancy.clinical.next.field_case: Place the Field Case to open it. Close all menus and let its lid shut before sneak-using an empty hand to recover it. Ask the Alchemist what belongs in its cells.
hemomancy.clinical.next.echo_referral: Examine three creature sources, then ask the Alchemist about the residual echo at Degree 2. Bring that referral here for formal study at Degree 3.
hemomancy.clinical.next.formal_study: Your Alchemist referral is recorded. At Degree 3, ask me for What Blood Remembers Saying to learn the Clairaudiograph and Wax Cylinder recipes.
hemomancy.clinical.next.recording: Use a filled creature vial and a blank Wax Cylinder in the Clairaudiograph. Choose a call and Carve. A carved cylinder can be played again without further blood.
hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.alchemist_fie: The Field Case carries clinical specimens. I teach which samples belong together; the Artificer teaches its field construction after my referral.
hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.alchemist_ech: The blood is identifiable, yet the auditory pattern survives ordinary analysis. After examining three creature sources, ask me about Beyond Ordinary Analysis and take the question to the Mnemonist.
hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.later: This belongs to a later lesson. Begin with the Alchemist's Degree-1 sampling and observation practice.
hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.sampling: The Living Syringe draws creature blood into an empty vial in its loaded eight-vial rack. Thick-skinned creatures and NPCs require it; a loose vial cannot draw their blood. Bring one filled vial to me before building a large collection. The microscope teaches you to distinguish what you collected.
hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.centrifuge: The Vial Centrifuge belongs to the Degree-2 laboratory work. Put valid creature samples in opposing slots and start a balanced spin. Recover the enzyme and report the assigned separation. The Ghastly Alembic is your other required proof before Concentrated Blood.
hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.alembic: At Degree 2, the Ghastly Alembic opens reagent distillation and broader tendency work. Microscopy describes a specimen; distillation and centrifugation separate useful material from it.
hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.empty_vial: An empty Blood Vial can collect a creature specimen with a left-click on a living creature. My First Separation briefing supplies two. Bring a filled vial back for microscopy.
hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.unidentified_: This vial contains a specimen, but you have not identified its properties. Show me a filled creature vial for the microscope lesson. Hold the microscope in your main hand and the sample in your offhand for a two-second examination.
hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.identified_vi: The identified vial records tendencies and biological properties. After my Borrowed Physiology lesson, hold Use with the vial for 0.8 seconds to inject it. Temporary responses and drawbacks are shown in the tooltip. The empty vessel remains and Transfusion Saturation prevents immediate repetition.
hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.artificer_cab: Bloodwood holds the cells; Hematic Iron reinforces the frame. The Alchemist teaches provenance and exact specimen matching. Once you have used that Cabinet, I can discuss its field conversion after the Alchemist's referral.
hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.artificer_mic: I can reproduce the housing. I cannot tell you why one bear's blood freezes in the glass while another's boils. Ask the Alchemist.
hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.artificer_rec: I understand its frame and moving parts. The Alchemist establishes the sample; the Mnemonist explains the retained voice. Ask them before treating it as an ordinary instrument.
hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.echo_hint: There may be an echo here, but physiology must precede interpretation. Examine three creature sources and seek the Alchemist's referral. At Degree 3 I can teach you how to retain the expression.
hemomancy.clinical.injection.locked: Examine a sample and learn Borrowed Physiology before injecting.

hemomancy.clinical.ledger.microscope.des: Hold a filled creature vial while speaking to the Alchemist; learn the Hematic Microscope recipe.

hemomancy.clinical.ledger.injection.desc: Learn direct injection from the Alchemist after your first personal examination.
hemomancy.clinical.ledger.sources.desc: Personally examine three different entity types. Duplicate sources count once; trading identified vials does not replace examination.

hemomancy.clinical.ledger.iron.desc: Obtain Hematic Iron Scraps and speak to the Artificer, then return to the Alchemist.
hemomancy.clinical.ledger.referral.desc: At Degree 2, complete Cabinet practice and ask the Alchemist for a field-conversion referral.
hemomancy.clinical.ledger.field_case.des: Take the Alchemist referral to the Artificer to learn the Field Case recipe and placement rules.
After three source identifications and Degree 2, ask the Alchemist for a Mnemonist referral.
hemomancy.clinical.ledger.clairaudiograp: At Degree 3, meet the Mnemonist and use the Alchemist referral to learn recording and cylinder recipes.
hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.blank_cylinde: This cylinder is blank. Make two ordinary Wax Cylinders from honeycomb, Active Befouling Ash, and paper. Set one beside a filled creature Blood Vial in the Clairaudiograph, select a call, and carve for four seconds. Ambergris works here too, but is required for lasting Masterwork patterns.
hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.carved_cylind: This cylinder already carries an expression. Place it in the Clairaudiograph and press Play. Playback needs no fresh blood, and this carved cylinder cannot serve as blank recording stock. Preview is private; Play reaches nearby listeners.
hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.unreadable_cy: The inscription on this cylinder cannot be read. Preserve it as it is; it is not blank wax. A changed or absent recording definition may explain the silence.
hemomancy.antecedent.sample.unknown: An opaque, gritty suspension. Examine it with a Hematic Microscope.
hemomancy.antecedent.sample.identified: Alive, but not blood. No tendency response. Reacts to vibration. Not suitable for injection or enzyme separation.
hemomancy.antecedent.microscope.readout:
SAMPLE ANALYSIS

SUBSTRATE: UNKNOWN
HEMATIC CONTENT: NONE DETECTED
TENDENCY: N/A
ENZYME RESPONSE: NULL

STIMULUS: ACOUSTIC
No nervous structures observed.
hemomancy.antecedent.microscope.unknown_:
