hemomancy.antecedent.cylinder.descriptio: An ancient ambergris cylinder bearing unfamiliar grooves. Play it in a Clairaudiograph; bring an analyzed dark sample.
hemomancy.antecedent.cylinder.lower_dist: Weathered Ambergris Cylinder: Lower District Survey
hemomancy.antecedent.recording.behind: [A click behind you; absent from the recording]
hemomancy.antecedent.recording.severed.1: Unknown Recorder: Lower district. Record nineteen.
hemomancy.antecedent.recording.severed.2: Unknown Recorder: The growth to the west has stopped.
hemomancy.antecedent.recording.severed.4: Unknown Recorder: It has not died. It stopped.
hemomancy.antecedent.recording.severed.5: Unknown Recorder: The catalysts still take the dead. The listeners still answer movement. Nothing there has changed.
hemomancy.antecedent.recording.severed.6: Unknown Recorder: But they do not answer one another the way they did.
hemomancy.antecedent.recording.severed.9: Distant Voice: Then why are they still alive?
hemomancy.antecedent.recording.severed.1: Unknown Recorder: We cut the voice.
hemomancy.antecedent.recording.survey.1: Unknown Recorder: Lower district survey. The growth takes the dead. The listeners answer movement, but do not go beyond the black floor.
hemomancy.antecedent.recording.survey.2: Distant Voice: Do not carry the growth upward. Keep the dead elsewhere. Mark the last clean stair.
Unknown Recorder: Do not ring bells below the third stair. No iron wheels. Wrap the road. Walk softly.
Distant Voice: If the floor answers twice, leave. If it answers three times, do not return for those below.
hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.initial_al: Let me see that vial. My microscope can't find a blood cell in it, but the material inside keeps moving together.
Tap the glass for me. See how it pulls back? I tested all eight tendencies, and none of them fit. I don't know what we're looking at.
The Vicar once warned me away from a similar account in the old histories. Take the sample to him and see if he remembers it.
Keep the vial. Try to learn what makes the material move, and search an Ancient City for records left by people who lived near it.
hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.initial_vi: The Alchemist sent me with this dark sample.
The Alchemist sent you because the sample doesn't behave like blood. He's right to ask, though I can't name it from a vial alone.
I know a passage that might describe something like it. The passage is old and vague, so I don't want to build a history around this one sample.
Go to an Ancient City and look for something its people recorded for themselves. An instruction or a field report would tell us more than a later account.
Bring back whatever you find, along with the vial. I want to compare the words with what the sample actually does.
I found an old recording beneath an Ancient City.
This cylinder is ambergris, but those grooves came from a different machine. The people who made it knew how to store a recording too.
You said part of it went silent. I can see another trace there on the spectrograph, even though our machine plays no sound from that section.
Bring your analyzed dark sample back. Put it in the Clairaudiograph or hold it beside the machine, then play the cylinder again.
After that, set the machine within eight blocks of me so I can watch a full replay. If the sample only reacts to sound, it should sit still through the silent part.
hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.replay.tit: The sample reacted during the silence.
hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.replay.1: The sample climbed the glass toward the machine? Tell me when. During the Shrieker, or afterward? During the silence. All right, let me see it.
hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.replay.2: I want to watch that happen myself. Set up the cylinder again.
hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.replay.3: Put the analyzed vial beside the machine and play the whole silent section while I'm within eight blocks. Watch the sound trace and the other one.
hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.replay.4: If the vial moves while the sound trace stays flat, we'll know ordinary sound isn't causing it.
hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.conclusion: What did the controlled replay establish?
I was wrong about the sample. Sound makes it move, but it also turned toward the machine when the recording fell silent.
The sound trace stayed flat the whole time. Something was still present in the grooves, and the sample seemed to sense it.
I can't tell you what that signal is. Our machine may be missing part of the sound, or the old recording may carry something else entirely.
The speaker also said they stopped the growth from answering itself without killing it. The Vicar may know what they meant. Take him the cylinder and the vial.
hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.recognitio: What did the old recording mean?
The speaker says they stopped the growth from answering itself, yet it stayed alive. I've seen that same account in our oldest histories.
Those histories describe a wound that never healed and living material that remained beneath it. They say the break held, but they never explain what was broken.
There's no author, date, or named rite. By the Second Age, people read it as a lesson in restraint. I did too. This recording makes that reading harder to accept.
If the speaker meant the sculk, they may have cut off a way for its parts to answer each other. The growth could survive even after that connection was gone.
That is still a guess. We have seen it react to a recording. We have not proved it speaks, remembers, or understands us.
Later writers called these fragments the Antecedent because they seem to describe something older than blood. We don't know what the people in that city called it.
Find the place where they watched the damaged growth. Their own records may tell us what they tried to separate and why they left the sculk alive. Ask me about the Last Listeners.
hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.clue.title: Where did the Last Listeners keep vigil?
hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.clue.1: The account points to a quiet place below the city, past the end of a wool-lined passage. The Last Listeners kept watch there.
hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.clue.2: Follow the Ancient City roads and look for a small, enclosed entrance. It could be beside any district. Go through the passage and keep going when the wool stops.
hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.clue.3: Leave the damaged structures alone while you're there. A missing piece may be the reason the growth cannot answer itself.
hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.clue.4: I don't know if their work held because they did it well or because nobody has tried to undo it. Please don't test that by putting anything back together.
hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.comparison: Could the Antecedent be the same Entity?
I see why you ask, but I can't tell you they came from the same Entity. So far, the similarities are only on the surface.
The sculk sample has no blood and answers none of the eight tendencies. The Alchemist can't draw an enzyme from it. Erythromycelium is made of something else entirely.
Their behavior gives us a better question. How does each one spread, and what does it need to stay alive?
Sculk stays in one area and feeds on the dead. Erythromycelium moves through living hosts. We would need much stronger evidence to claim they share an origin.
hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.housing.1: The archive shows how they built a small listening device. If you bring me four iron nuggets and one Echo Shard, I can make its housing.
hemomancy.antecedent.dialogue.housing.2: Hold the housing in one hand and an analyzed Ahaematic vial in the other, then use the housing to load it. Keep it beside the Clairaudiograph through the full silent section. When it wakes, you can fit it to your Charm at a Scarlet Vanity or remove it there later.
hemomancy.antecedent.epilogue:
You found us under the stone.

We remember listening here, waiting for the dead to come. We waited a long time.

We don't wait for them now.
hemomancy.antecedent.scar.instructions.0: Hold analyzed Ahaematic Colloid in the other hand and use this. It returns the empty vial.
hemomancy.antecedent.scar.instructions.1: Hold beside the Clairaudiograph through the entire silent response.
hemomancy.antecedent.scar.instructions.2: Fit it to your Charm at a Scarlet Vanity. You cannot hear the sculk. You can hear it listen.
hemomancy.antecedent.housing.cost: Reconstruction needs four iron nuggets and one Echo Shard.
hemomancy.antecedent.vigil.title: THE ANTECEDENT: THE LAST LISTENERS
hemomancy.antecedent.vigil.subtitle: Pass where the wool ends.
hemomancy.antecedent.cylinder.playback_h: Ancient recording. Playback preserves the cylinder and any specimen.
hemomancy.antecedent.scar.socket: Listening Scar socket. Fit or remove it at a Scarlet Vanity.
tooltip.hemomancy.advanced_brew.substitu: 20%% chance to spend 1,000 mL of your blood instead of a dose
tooltip.hemomancy.advanced_brew.nerve_su: Slowness I for 8 seconds when the surge ends or is removed
tooltip.hemomancy.advanced_brew.fervent_: Direct melee attackers ignite for 2 seconds; 5-second cooldown
hemomancy.alchemist.brewing.condenser.re: Distil something at an ordinary Alembic and take the result from it yourself. Keep your blood awake and reach the fourth Degree; then I will trust you with a Condenser kit.

You have seen what the Alembic separates. Take this Condenser Kit to a lit brazier on a working lesser Cardinal floor, with five more offerings beside it. Seat the Alembic one plinth behind the Focus; its two blood circuits must close in order.
hemomancy.alchemist.brewing.condenser.cl: The Condenser Kit is yours, and you know now how to build another. A canceled rite returns every offering. A finished Condenser increases your tank from 5,000 to 7,500 mL without adding blood, and keeps that capacity when you move it.
hemomancy.alchemist.brewing.athanor.requ: Take a distillation result yourself, then finish a refinement and a two-effect compound at a Condenser and take each result yourself. At the sixth Degree, with your blood awake, the greater circuit is yours. Accepting my earlier kit is not required.
hemomancy.alchemist.brewing.athanor.read: This Athanor Kit belongs to a Condenser on a working greater Cardinal floor. Set it on a lit brazier with five more offerings, then feed the three marked bulbs in order.
hemomancy.alchemist.brewing.athanor.clai: The Athanor's new socket holds your second catalyst, and its tank keeps the Condenser's 7,500 mL capacity. Its mantle supplies permanent heat with no block underneath, and every Alembic recipe takes half the time. A canceled rite returns every offering, though blood already spent is gone; a finished Athanor keeps its tier when you move it.
hemomancy.jei.advanced_brewing.bind.hint: Base potion becomes the bound vessel
hemomancy.jei.advanced_brewing.refill.hi: Either catalyst order; adds one dose
tooltip.hemomancy.resonant_pattern.singl: The wax yields after one application
screen.hemomancy.resonant_forge.selectio: Choose the complete pattern, one enchantment, or the Scriptorium curse
screen.hemomancy.resonant_forge.status.h: The hammer head must be rebuilt
screen.hemomancy.resonant_forge.status.c: That cylinder already carries a recording or pattern
screen.hemomancy.resonant_forge.status.s: Precision selection requires the D5 upgrade
screen.hemomancy.resonant_forge.status.m: Master cylinders require the D7 upgrade
Master patterns need an Ambergris Cylinder
screen.hemomancy.resonant_forge.status.u: The target cannot carry this enchantment
screen.hemomancy.resonant_forge.status.i: The recorded pattern conflicts with the target
screen.hemomancy.resonant_forge.status.d: The target bears a different Scriptorium curse
screen.hemomancy.resonant_forge.status.u: The target cannot bear this Scriptorium curse
screen.hemomancy.resonant_forge.status.n: The pattern would make no change
screen.hemomancy.resonant_forge.status.i: The held work changed; blood was returned
message.hemomancy.resonant_forge.hammer_: The hammer head is too worn to open the forge.
hemomancy.artificer.resonant_forge.title: Ask about the Resonant Forge
hemomancy.artificer.resonant_forge.early: You can build the Resonant Forge at the third Degree with an anvil, cauldron, grindstone, Hematic Iron, Ferric Binder, 500 mL of blood, and a blank Wax Cylinder. It is optional work now. At the fourth Degree I will walk you through the full transfer.
hemomancy.artificer.resonant_forge.lesso: Set enchanted equipment and a blank Wax Cylinder on the grinding side, keep blood in the basin, and start the wheel. It cuts the pattern out, leaving cleaned equipment and an engraved cylinder in separate outputs.
hemomancy.artificer.resonant_forge.taugh: Move the engraved cylinder beside target equipment on the hammer side and start application. Compatible enchantments carry over; an ordinary cylinder is consumed. Ambergris also works for ordinary patterns. Tend the hammer and wheel when they wear.
hemomancy.artificer.resonant_forge.pract: At the sixth Degree, practice transferring a Scriptorium curse or a chosen enchantment. The base wheel moves a whole pattern; a Precision governor can select one part. This is practice on the same forge, not a new tier.
hemomancy.artificer.resonant_forge.preci: Grind one pattern into wax and hammer one pattern back into a tool. At the fifth Degree I will give you a governor steady enough to separate one vibration from the rest.

Take the Precision Governor Kit. Seat your forge behind a Cardinal Focus, set the kit and five more offerings on lit braziers, and close the two marked grooves with 250 mL of blood each. Then the wheel can choose one enchantment, or the curse beneath them.
The governor is yours. The Rite of the True Groove changes the same forge and keeps its blood, tools, and wear.
hemomancy.artificer.resonant_forge.maste: Learn grinding and application, then grind a single chosen vibration out of a tool at a Precision Forge yourself. At the seventh Degree, with your blood awake, the Master Cam is yours. My earlier gift need not have been claimed.
Take the Master Cam Kit. Set it with five more offerings on lit braziers. The Rite of the Enduring Pattern has three points: reader, hammer, and stabilizer. Give each 250 mL, in order.
The master cam can stabilize an engraved Ambergris Cylinder. Stabilization costs 1,000 mL, but the cylinder survives every proper application. Ordinary wax cannot hold a master pattern.
hemomancy.initiation.ask: I wish to be formally introduced to the Harbingers.
hemomancy.initiation.offer: The charm has not yet settled. Before I receive you into the Order, choose freely. I can still remove it and release you.
hemomancy.initiation.reason: An undedicated Harbinger is no good to us. Often worse than an accidental one. I would rather free you now than bind someone who has no wish to remain.
hemomancy.initiation.accept: I choose to remain. Initiate me.
hemomancy.initiation.remove: Remove the charm. I want to be free.
hemomancy.initiation.released: The Vicar draws out the unsettled charm. Its pulse falls silent. You are free.
hemomancy.initiation.bloodline: Your blood has settled into %s. You belong to this bloodline now.
hemomancy.initiation.welcome: You are a Neophyte of the Crimson Veil. Take this Sanguine Conduit. The Vicar has four first bloodcraft proofs for you; your ledger records them in any order.
hemomancy.initiation.cannot_attach: The heart cannot attach while your vascular scar is occupied or you already bear awakened blood.
hemomancy.initiation.blood_rest: Inject the Concentrated Blood as you would a blood shot. Then give it a chance to settle. A night's rest will do more than standing here waiting.
hemomancy.initiation.awakened: The concentrated blood has settled into your circulation. You wake as an Initiate of the Incarnadine Fane.
hemomancy.initiation.replace: Give me a vial of Concentrated Blood.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.vicar_path: We are the Harbingers, keepers of the Covenant of blood. Our path begins at a Hermit's Blood Temple, not at this outpost. Seek a temple and speak with its Hermit. Follow the Hermitage's path there. If all goes well, return to me and we will discuss your next step.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.alchemist: The Vicar can tell you who we are. Speak with them before you put your hands to any of my apparatus.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.artificer: New to the outpost? The Vicar explains the Covenant better than I do. Go speak with them.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.cicatrix_anc: You have no place on my table yet. Find the Vicar and ask what road brought us here.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.mnemonist: You are looking for a beginning. The Vicar can give you the shape of it.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.voyager: Found the outpost before the road? Ask the Vicar who we are and where to start.
hemomancy.dialogue.newcomer.votary_wayfa: The Vicar will explain the Covenant. Speak with them before setting out again.
hemomancy.dialogue.ending.vicar.undecide: The record has no ending to enter for you yet. There is work still open.
hemomancy.dialogue.ending.vicar.silent_p: You have refused the call. That is a choice, not yet a victory. Return after Vesper is defeated.
hemomancy.dialogue.ending.vicar.silent_a: Vesper has fallen. Your refusal stands, Silent Archon. The Order's rites remain yours.
hemomancy.dialogue.ending.vicar.apotheos: You have chosen Apotheosis, but the rite is not finished. I will keep the records until it is.
The Apotheosis is complete. I can still tend the Order's rites and unfinished obligations.
hemomancy.dialogue.ending.alchemist.unde: There is work ahead I cannot measure yet. The workshop stays open for what you need.
hemomancy.dialogue.ending.alchemist.sile: Refusal is recorded; Vesper is still ahead. The workshop stays open for repairs and preparations.
You came back from Vesper. I can still make and mend the instruments you use.
hemomancy.dialogue.ending.alchemist.apot: The Apotheosis is underway, not complete. Tell me what the apparatus needs.
The machines still work. Bring me what needs mending.
hemomancy.dialogue.ending.artificer.unde: The frame is not finished just because you reached Archon. Bring it back when the next strain shows itself.
hemomancy.dialogue.ending.artificer.sile: A refusal needs a frame that survives Vesper. Bring the damaged pieces back.
You held against Vesper. I can still fit the armature and finish work you left here.
hemomancy.dialogue.ending.artificer.apot: The rite is not over. I can still fit the frame for what comes next.
Your frame has changed. Show me what still needs fitting.
hemomancy.dialogue.ending.mnemonist.unde: I can record what you have seen. I will not give a name to what has not happened.
hemomancy.dialogue.ending.mnemonist.sile: You have refused, but the record is not finished until Vesper falls.
Your return from Vesper is in the record. Older lessons are still here if you need them.
hemomancy.dialogue.ending.mnemonist.apot: I can preserve the record of the rite, but I will not call it finished yet.
The record says Apotheos. I can still help you recover the memories you came here for.
hemomancy.dialogue.action.confirm: Review what this choice will do, then continue when you are ready.
hemomancy.dialogue.conversation.prompt: What else did you want to discuss?
This observance will be entered in your book with its offering and reward. Take it only if you mean to finish the work.
You already carry this observance. Your book records what remains. Return when the offering is ready.
The work is complete. Present the offering now, and I will mark the observance fulfilled.
hemomancy.clinical.microscope.prompt: You brought me a viable sample. I can teach you how to read it under the Hematic Microscope and add the design to your notes.
hemomancy.clinical.injection.prompt: You have examined blood closely enough to understand the risk. I can now teach you how to borrow its physiology.
hemomancy.clinical.cabinet.prompt: Three distinct sources are enough to begin a proper collection. I can show you how to build and use a Phlebotomist's Cabinet.
hemomancy.clinical.field_referral.prompt: Your cabinet work is sound, and you have met the Artificer. I can write the referral that turns laboratory storage into field equipment.
hemomancy.clinical.field_case.prompt: The Alchemist's referral is in order. I can show you how to rebuild a Cabinet for travel without losing its specimens.
hemomancy.clinical.echo_referral.prompt: Your samples carry something physiology cannot explain. I can refer that residue to the Mnemonist for formal study.
hemomancy.clinical.clairaudiograph.promp: The Alchemist has named the specimen. I can teach you to carve what its blood remembers saying.
hemomancy.alchemist.brewing.condenser.pr: You have done the lesser work and brought enough evidence. I can release the Condenser Kit and explain the rite that seats it.
hemomancy.alchemist.brewing.athanor.prom: Your Condenser work is proven. I can release the Athanor Kit and show you the greater circuit.
hemomancy.scout.take_notes.prompt: Give me your hands. Take the journal now, while I can still pass it to you.
hemomancy.zealot.take_vows.prompt: The five vows are work, not ceremony. Take them only if you intend to serve the Church until each is done.
hemomancy.alchemist.artificer_three_answ: The Artificer's inspection is enough. I have the reagent that matches the armor family you chose. Take it and put that answer to work.
hemomancy.alchemist.artificer_crimson_ve: The consecrated frame has been inspected. I can issue the Crimson Lacquer you need to finish the vestment.
hemomancy.alchemist.armor_research.claim: Your Bestiary holds the three records I asked for. Let me compare them with the Artificer's work before I issue another reagent.
hemomancy.alchemist.living_bestiary.reco: Keep the specimen intact. I only need the observations entered into your Bestiary.
hemomancy.alchemist.living_bestiary.surr: If you surrender the jar, the specimen will be consumed by the study. Make certain you are finished with it.
Choose which living layer you are surrendering. The selected polyp will be consumed by the study.
You are carrying one of the blood-fed fungi I asked for. Hand it over, and I will add the result to your taxonomy.
hemomancy.alchemist.first_separation.cla: The enzyme has survived a balanced spin. Show me the result, and I will close the assignment and issue your next supplies.
hemomancy.alchemist.body_answers.prompt: You have learned what blood separates into. I can now show you how those answers are brewed back into the body.
hemomancy.vicar.hermit_road.report.promp: You found a remnant without being led to it. Present the evidence, and I will issue the ledger that records your formal work.
Your ledger bears all four proofs. The Vicar can grant you the Second Degree.
hemomancy.vicar.masons_respite.prompt: The next instruction cannot be given at this outpost. I will mark the road to Masons Respite and the Vein-Mason who waits there.
hemomancy.anchorite.d5.diagnosis.prompt: Let me read the vessel before you treat it. Once I name the injury, the correct medicine will be clear.
hemomancy.anchorite.d5.reward.prompt: You have learned injury, treatment, and preparation. I can entrust you with the deeper pattern.
hemomancy.anchorite.d6.referral.prompt: This question belongs to the Mnemonist. Take my referral, hear their counsel, then return to prove the route.
hemomancy.anchorite.d6.reward.prompt: You changed the route and made it bear another instruction. The final pattern is yours.
hemomancy.anchorite.first_lesson.prompt: Your strongest tendency has chosen the first cut. Accept the pattern, then carve it at the Scarring Station exactly as I have told you.
The first wound answered another wound. Accept the next pattern when you are ready to choose instead of obey.
hemomancy.anchorite.replace_pattern.prom: I can replace the last pattern I entrusted to you. Take another only if the first is truly lost.
hemomancy.mnemonist.anchorite_counsel.pr: The Anchorite sent you because the memory and the scar must agree. Accept my counsel, then return and prove both routes.
hemomancy.hermit.archon_wisdom.prompt: Ask, Archon. I have kept what wisdom I could from dust and blood. I will place it in your hands.
hemomancy.artificer.resonant_forge.promp: The forge copies an enchantment's cadence into ambergris wax and hammers it into another tool. If you mean to build one, I will put the pattern in your notes.
hemomancy.artificer.resonant_forge.preci: You know the base forge and have reached the fifth Degree. I can issue the Precision Governor Kit for the next rite.
hemomancy.artificer.resonant_forge.maste: Your precision forge is ready for its final mechanism. I can issue the Master Cam Kit and the rite that seats it.
hemomancy.dialogue.recruit.release.promp: Ending the pact removes this Harbinger from your bloodline. If that is your decision, say it plainly.
hemomancy.dialogue.guardian.replace_abso: The dagger I issued was lost. I can replace it, but only while you remain fit to carry one.
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.absorpti: How do I absorb enough blood?
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.projecti: How do I condense a formation, and make Venous Stone?
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.rooted_v: How do I begin a Cardinal rite?
hemomancy.vicar.votary.rooted_vein.floor: Start with the Rite of the Rooted Vein. It changes the world, so it is held on a Dominion floor: a Lesser square of deepslate tiles or bricks studded with eight Chiseled Hematic Iron blocks around a Cardinal Focus. No copper: that is the Unstained metal, and it will not hold our pattern. Making belongs to the Working floor; your initiation stood on the Threshold.
hemomancy.vicar.votary.rooted_vein.offer: Keep the block above the Focus clear. Set one Blood Rock in an Iron Brazier on a floor socket, then light it with Blood Projection. Leave the Focus's medium slot empty. No helper, support sigil, or second offering is required.
hemomancy.vicar.votary.rooted_vein.staff: Use your Living Staff on the Focus. With Blood Projection, feed the four anchors, then project into the daemon to seal the rite. Stay inside the boundary while it consumes the offering and returns. Your degree and active blood still decide which rites answer.
hemomancy.vicar.votary.rooted_vein.recov: The Focus becomes Venous Stone with a permanent Earthen Vein above it. To cancel before completion, hold Blood Absorption on the planted Staff until it returns. Paid anchor blood and offerings already consumed are spent; an untouched offering stays in its brazier.
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.liber_bl: Give me the Liber Sanguinium blueprint.
hemomancy.dialogue.vicar.option.iron_blu: Give me the Hematic Iron blueprint.
hemomancy.vicar.neophyte.absorption_hint: Hold Blood Absorption toward a living creature or a blood reservoir. The ledger counts blood that enters your vessel, not blood from a flask or passive recovery. You need 500 ml total.
hemomancy.vicar.neophyte.projection_hint: Two lessons, two targets. Pour your blood into an empty cauldron and it will hold it, and in time crystallize a Sanguine Formation. Take it out yourself. Pour it instead into ordinary stone and the stone drinks it and stains to Venous Stone.
hemomancy.vicar.neophyte.crafting_hint: Craft Foul Paste from Nether Wart, gunpowder, and bone meal, then smelt it into Befouling Ash. Ask me for a Mnemonic Blueprint, build either pattern, hold its catalyst in your offhand, and project blood into the center.
hemomancy.dialogue.alchemist.option.firs: What is my first Alembic assignment?
hemomancy.alchemist.votary.first_distill: Make a Ghastly Alembic, complete one ordinary distillation, and take the result. First Separation proves you can recover an enzyme; the Alembic proves you can use blood as a reagent. After both, ask me for Concentrated Blood.
hemomancy.alchemist.first_separation.nex: Your tools wait if your inventory is full. Your next proof is one completed Ghastly Alembic distillation. Take its result, then ask me for Concentrated Blood.
screen.hemomancy.harbinger_assignment_le: Project blood into an empty cauldron, wait for it to crystallize, and collect the formation yourself.
Project blood into ordinary stone to produce Venous Stone.
Use a projected blood-structure recipe to create either a Liber Sanguinium or Hematic Iron Block.
Show the Vicar all four proofs to receive Degree 2.
container.hemomancy.alembic.containers.t: Filled vessels supply the tank; empty vessels bottle its blood.
Tinctures use an empty flask or jug here and blood from the tank.
message.hemomancy.vial_centrifuge.blocke: Clear space for hematic iron powder.
message.hemomancy.vial_centrifuge.rite_l: The centrifuge is held by an upgrade rite.
Your separation work is proven. I can give you a governor and teach its two circuits.
Balance a spin and take an ordinary specimen result yourself. First Separation already proves this. At the fourth Degree, with your blood awake, I can give you a Centrifugal Governor Kit.

Steady rotation leaves less behind. Take this governor to a lit brazier with an Iron Ingot, Chain, Sanguine Glass, Ferric Binder, and Neurotic Enzyme. On a Greater working floor, seat the base centrifuge two blocks behind the Focus. Fill four anchors, close two 50 mL circuits, then finish the procession.

The governor gives a quarter more primary material on average, finishes a spin in seven and a half seconds, and recovers iron powder from three vials in four on average. Keep opposing vials balanced. You know how to craft another kit; a canceled rite returns offerings and Staff, not spent blood.
hemomancy.alchemist.centrifuge.fractiona: You have worked with the calibrated rotor. I can teach you to recover a second fraction.

Take an ordinary specimen result from a completed calibrated or fractionating spin yourself. At the sixth Degree, with your blood awake and earlier separation proven, the next rotor is yours. My first gift need not have been claimed.

A mixed specimen can leave another useful fraction behind. Set this kit on a lit brazier with an Amethyst Shard, Ghast Tear, Hematic Iron Block, Chromatic Sublimate, and Enzyme Primer. Seat the calibrated centrifuge two blocks behind the Focus on a Greater working floor. Fill eight anchors, close three 50 mL circuits, and finish the procession.

A spin now takes five seconds and returns half again as much primary material on average. Every ordinary vial gives one iron powder. Half of mixed specimens also give one item of a different fraction, drawn only from their own blood profile. Clear room in the eight shared output slots for both fractions. Sacred syringes still yield one residuum.
hemomancy.clinical.inquiry.centrifuge_up: At the fourth Degree, the Alchemist teaches a governor after personal separation. At the sixth, personal recovery from a calibrated spin earns a fractionating rotor. Both are Cardinal upgrades of this same machine; a gifted or crafted kit cannot stand in for practice.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.chiton.title: Chiton
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.chiton.descr: Eight overlapping plates seal a grazing foot against the rock. Its iron-rich blood can only be drawn with a Living Syringe.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.chiton.sourc: Wet coastal stone on Rockpool Shores. Capture in a Specimen Jar for the Living Bestiary.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.pyrosome.des: A hollow living colony; waves of light pass between its small, coordinated bodies.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.pyrosome.sou: Open Pelagic water, with occasional Twilight visitors. Capture in a Specimen Jar for the Living Bestiary.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.pelagic_herr: A swift silver shoaler whose crimson lateral line follows the turn of its neighbors.
Schools of six to ten in the open Pelagic Ocean. Capture in a Specimen Jar for the Living Bestiary.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.siphonophore: A Ductilis colonial swimmer whose hanging tentacles zap small fish in the deeper Pelagic water column.
Twilight waters and adjacent Pelagic layers. Player kills yield ordinary Ganglion Clusters, not the unique Naeglerophaeon organ.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.bloody_belly: Transparent lobes reveal a crimson gut while moving comb rows catch the dark water's light.
Midnight water, with sparse Twilight and Carrion visitors. Capture in a Specimen Jar for the Living Bestiary.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.hagfish.desc: A jawless scavenger of old bones. Disturbance draws a brief veil of slime before it withdraws.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.hagfish.sour: Carrion fossil sites; accepts rotten flesh offered by hand. Capture in a Specimen Jar for the Living Bestiary.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.vampire_squi: Eight curling arms bear a crimson web lined with pale barbs. When threatened, the web folds around the mantle as the squid retreats.
Open water in Carrion and Hydrothermal Depths. Drops Barbed Splinters; capture in a Specimen Jar for the Living Bestiary.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.osteophage.d: A skeletal bearded vulture roosting on valley fossils. It climbs above skeleton prey before striking, then grinds loose bones in its hooked beak.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.osteophage.s: Soul Sand Valley bone formations. Offer dropped bones; player kills yield Venous Pinions. Capture in a Specimen Jar for the Living Bestiary.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.ice_fish.des: A pale, broad-headed fish swimming in cold-water schools. Its haemoglobin-free circulation is regarded by the Unstained as naturally pure.
bestiary.hemomancy.specimen.ice_fish.sou: Cold and frozen oceans, Frozen Rivers and submerged Ice Spikes pools. Drops Cleansing Hemolymph; capture in a Specimen Jar for the Living Bestiary.
hemomancy.circus.school.instruction_requ: A professor must teach this shape before you can begin its Cardinal Ordeal.
hemomancy.circus.school.ask_history: How did you join the Troupe?
hemomancy.circus.school.ask_colleagues: What do you think of the other professors?
hemomancy.circus.school.ask_aftermath: What happens to the school after the final act?
hemomancy.circus.school.testimony: Tell me about the wrong audience and the missing understudy.
hemomancy.circus.school.guest: Perform a guest act using this exercise.
hemomancy.circus.school.conductor: Tell me about the school and its conductor.
hemomancy.circus.school.not_ready: Instruction requires active blood and the professor's initiatory degree. Your lesson has not been recorded.
hemomancy.circus.school.inspected: This Crossbar is attuned to you and charged. Learn a shape, defeat its ordeal, then call, command and recall a body with this same Crossbar.
hemomancy.circus.school.inspect_failed: Hold your own attuned Crossbar with some charge. I cannot inspect someone else's instrument.
hemomancy.circus.school.unlock_first: Unlock this shape through its Cardinal Ordeal first. A guest act also requires a passed practical and an available daily reward.
hemomancy.circus.school.ring_blocked: The practice space is blocked or wet. Clear it and return for the exercise.
hemomancy.circus.school.retry: Your practical has ended. Return to the professor to retry; earned instruction and completed work remain recorded.
hemomancy.circus.school.passed: Your professor records the completed act. Well controlled.
hemomancy.circus.school.report_complete: Your completed work is recorded. The school recognizes your progress.
hemomancy.circus.school.report_incomplet: There is still work to observe. Consult the Side section of your Assignment Ledger for the next step.
hemomancy.circus.school.reward: Guest payment processed. %s Filaments remain reserved for collection from a Threadkeeper.
hemomancy.circus.school.preparation: Attune a Marionette Crossbar to yourself, charge it at a Puppeteer's Spindle, and keep spare Filaments. Instruction reveals an ordeal recipe; it does not unlock a shape. The Cardinal Ordeal still requires its degree, blood, frame and reusable Crossbar. Practicals use your own known bodies, normal charge and existing commands. Two live rehearsal threats await you; stay within twenty blocks of this professor and finish within five minutes. You may recall or leave to retry.
hemomancy.circus.school.status.preparati: The Threadhouse handles Crossbars, Filaments, inspection and reports. The Ringmaster conducts the final act.
hemomancy.circus.school.status.degree: You have not reached the degree required for my shape. You can still study its construction and our history.
hemomancy.circus.school.status.lesson: You are ready for personal instruction. Ask me to teach you this shape.
hemomancy.circus.school.status.ordeal: Your instruction is recorded. Prepare the frame and defeat this shape's Cardinal Ordeal.
hemomancy.circus.school.status.practical: You know the shape. Call it with your own Crossbar and prove its purpose in my rehearsal ring.
hemomancy.circus.school.status.mastered: Your practical is complete. You may repeat the exercise as a paid guest act once per Minecraft day.
hemomancy.circus.school.aftermath.neutra: The Ringmaster's bargain remains unresolved. Lessons are available without accepting either ending.
hemomancy.circus.school.aftermath.succes: You have chosen Succession. Its final act follows the existing Ringmaster challenges; apprenticeship adds no requirement.
hemomancy.circus.school.aftermath.libera: You have chosen Liberation. Severing the captive strings kills the bound people; it does not release three living prisoners.
hemomancy.circus.school.aftermath.succes: Succession leaves the pavilion standing and grants its Pattern. The professors continue teaching, even those who distrust your bargain.
hemomancy.circus.school.aftermath.libera: The captives and Ringmaster are dead, and the carousel is ruined. We teach at the surviving camps. No triumph can bring those people back.
hemomancy.circus.school.ringmaster.curri: The Crimson Troupe is a school as well as a show. The Acrobat teaches pursuit, the Dagger Thrower focus, the Stilt Walker attention, the Strongman protection, the Beast Tamer rupture, the Fire Breather restraint, and the Retired Understudy memory. Their instruction prepares an ordeal. Victory earns the shape. A practical earns trust.
hemomancy.circus.school.ringmaster.facul: The Threadkeeper prepares your instrument. I teach coordination through the existing final act. A pupil may finish every lesson and decline my offer, or enter my act without earning every professor's approval. The Brined Court is our neighboring faction, not the authority that grants your Crossbar its strings.
hemomancy.circus.school.clue.stage: A torn programme names an understudy in the role of a living person. The pencilled correction changes the role to "carousel support." Find the rigging account in the pavilion loft.
hemomancy.circus.school.clue.loft: The rigging account records three substitutions, with the same names copied into the carousel's passenger tally. A margin notes that their rooms were never reassigned. Search the understudy quarters.
hemomancy.circus.school.clue.quarters: Three unused beds and an unfinished letter contradict the announcement that the understudies left on tour. The Retired Understudy can identify the missing performers. Examine the carousel tally itself.
hemomancy.circus.school.clue.carousel: The carousel tally confirms that the three missing performers are its bound captives. Severing the strings is lethal. Bring this evidence and the Retired Understudy's testimony to a Threadkeeper.
hemomancy.circus.school.ledger.title: Crimson Troupe Apprenticeship
hemomancy.circus.school.ledger.guest.pen: Your payment is reserved. Make inventory space and collect it from any Threadkeeper.
hemomancy.circus.school.ledger.guest.ava: After passing a practical, repeat that professor's exercise for four Filaments, once per Minecraft day.
hemomancy.circus.school.circus_acrobat.w: A Vulture does not win by hovering over your shoulder. Give it a line to pursue, then a reason to return.
hemomancy.circus.school.circus_acrobat.h: I learned rigging before I learned blood. One snapped line taught me the difference between a body that falls and a body that chooses its descent. My Vultures still carry that lesson in their wing joints.
hemomancy.circus.school.circus_acrobat.c: The Strongman calls retreat a waste of a good lift. I call it the second half of a successful pursuit. The Fire Breather understands: an act needs a recovery as much as an entrance.
hemomancy.circus.school.circus_acrobat.l: Watch the wing spars and the scarlet tendons. The Veinwing Vulture is a constructed aerial striker, not a natural bird. At Degree 3, prepare its existing frame and Cardinal Ordeal. In the practical it must pursue a rehearsal threat from the air, hit it, and return when recalled.
hemomancy.circus.school.circus_acrobat.a: I will keep the ropes serviceable for the next pupil. A new conductor does not get to tell the wings how to remember flight.
hemomancy.circus.school.circus_acrobat.t: The wrong audience watched our hands instead of the act. I saw an understudy climb down from the loft, then saw their name disappear from the next programme.
hemomancy.circus.school.circus_knife_thr: Six hands are useful only when they agree on one target. My Juggler wears three faces so you can see how often they disagree.

I used to throw one knife and congratulate myself for hitting. The Juggler taught me that the empty hands between throws matter. A laughing mask, a grieving mask, and a blank one share the same suspended frame.
The Stilt Walker says a distracted enemy is a defeated enemy. I say distraction buys time for a deliberate throw. We argue because both of us have seen a careless pupil harm the audience.

The Marrow Juggler is the shape older records call a Marrow Spitter. Its ordeal and Crossbar identity remain the same. At Degree 3, prepare the existing offering, unlock it, then command a full three-dagger volley into one rehearsal threat. The three throws share one attack's strength.
If the pavilion survives, I will teach in its blade ring. If it falls, a wagon floor will do. I do not intend to let the Ringmaster own the next generation of hands.

That audience applauded when a puppet took a bow, but not when a performer did. I recognized the expression: they wanted obedience, not craft. Speak to the Stilt Walker and prove you can focus without surrendering control.
hemomancy.circus.school.circus_stilt_wal: The Scarlet Mummer borrows an enemy's attention. Borrow it long enough for somebody else to breathe.
Above the crowd, I could see who was actually watching and who was looking for a way out. I built the Mummer to give those frightened people another place to look.
The Dagger Thrower wants one perfect target. I want several imperfect ones looking away from a pupil. The Beast Tamer trusts the split pack; I trust the shared glance.

At Degree 4, learn the Scarlet Mummer, complete its existing Cardinal Ordeal, and bring your own known body here. The practical requires it to divert both rehearsal threats while they are pursuing you or an allied puppet. Its pulse and one evasive step remain its real abilities.
A mask can still protect a pupil after a conductor loses their stage. I will not call a dead captive a liberated student.

The wrong audience could not distinguish an act from a command. The missing understudies stopped choosing their entrances before they disappeared. Ask the Dagger Thrower, then show me attention used to protect somebody.
hemomancy.circus.school.circus_strongman: The Hulk's broad shoulders are a promise. Put it where the danger will arrive and let it keep that promise.
My first body could lift a wagon and could not keep a door open for one frightened child. That was strength without purpose. The belt and tendon bindings make this one's load visible.
The Acrobat knows when to leave. I know where to remain. A conductor who cannot value both will break every string they own.

At Degree 4, prepare the existing Gorebound Hulk offering and finish its Cardinal Ordeal. In my practical, anchor Guard inside this ring, keep the Hulk guarding for five seconds, and have it strike a rehearsal threat while guarding. The small head, lifting belt and heavy forearms belong to a constructed strongman; its existing strength and cost remain.
I can rebuild a practice ring. I cannot rebuild the people under that carousel. Any successor who forgets that can practice alone.
I was told the understudies had taken a travelling engagement. Their luggage remained under their beds. Find the rooms before you repeat that lie.
hemomancy.circus.school.circus_beast_tam: A Hound's rupture changes the pack. Command the body carefully, then let its temporary Curs finish the pursuit.
I joined with a cage and learned to leave it empty. A constructed Hound is bound by a Crossbar; an animal has its own needs. The Court's living creatures deserve more than our stage language.
The Stilt Walker holds attention in one place. My pack spreads it out. The Fire Breather worries about singeing a Cur; that concern is exactly why I trust their lessons.

At Degree 4, prepare the existing Sanguine Hound bridle and Cardinal Ordeal. In the practical, allow your Hound to rupture under the rehearsal threats' attacks, then have one of its temporary Blood Curs land a hit. A Cur cannot be learned, called separately, or kept as another permanent shape.
The pack does not need a pavilion to learn its route. Other camps keep teaching when this site is finished.
Three names vanished from our travelling roster, yet their rations still appeared on the pavilion account. The loft's copied tally is more trustworthy than a farewell announced from a stage.
hemomancy.circus.school.circus_fire_eate: The coil steadies the body; the lung-sac steadies the breath. Fire is the final step, not the first.

The oldest frame I inherited stood on brittle legs. I gave it a serpent's lower body so the gaunt upper half could spend its effort on the lungs. The open ribs let a pupil read the pressure before the mouth opens.
The Beast Tamer makes me account for every allied body in the ring. The Strongman likes a conspicuous wind-up. Both are right: a dangerous act ought to announce itself.

At Degree 4, build a Cinder Bellows Frame from hematic iron scraps, leather, Filaments and blaze powder. Its Dominion Lesser ordeal requires 900 mL and consumes the frame only after manifestation, preserving your Crossbar. Your Bellows inhales for one second, breathes a five-block, sixty-degree cone for two seconds, then recovers for two. The practical requires both rehearsal threats to be hit during one breath. Walls and allies must be respected; the act never ignites terrain.
We can perform among ruins without setting them alight. Let the surviving camps be where pupils learn control again.
I saw the three understudies rehearsing ordinary entrances. The Ringmaster later called their absence a change in casting. I did not see them leave the grounds.
hemomancy.circus.school.circus_understud: A Mnemonist body repeats an observed attack. First give it a real memory; then listen for its echo.
An understudy learns another person's pauses, mistakes and recoveries. I retired before the Ringmaster decided that a perfect replacement should never need a choice of its own.
The Threadkeeper keeps accounts because memory alone is easy to bend. The Juggler's blank face troubles me less than a conductor who insists every remembered face belongs to them.

At Degree 5, complete the Mnemonist Puppet's existing ordeal. During the practical, strike a rehearsal threat yourself while your known puppet observes, then keep that threat in its range until it actually replays the recorded attack. Ordinary puppet melee is not an echo.
The missing performers were people. A surviving school must keep their names, whether a successor takes the Pattern or the carousel ends in blood.

Those three entries are the missing understudies. Their beds were not abandoned for a tour. The stage programme, loft account and quarters tell one story; the carousel tally confirms what the Ringmaster made of them.
hemomancy.circus.school.circus_threadkee: Bring your own instrument. I inspect the binding; the professors teach what you put on its strings.
I once counted ticket money. Now I count Crossbar charge, spare Filaments and the pupils who return to report. A good account tells you what remains owed.
The Ringmaster promises a grand final act. The faculty promise a pupil can call, control and dismiss one body safely. I prefer to start with the promise we can inspect.

The first assignment is An Empty Ring. Hold an attuned, charged Crossbar for inspection, learn any shape, complete its ordeal, then call, command and recall with that same Crossbar. Report here. Every professor records their own practical; story investigations and paid guest performances appear in the Side ledger.
Teaching belongs to the scattered camps as well as this pavilion. Completed work and owed guest payment follow the pupil, not the building.

To investigate the wrong audience, collect the Stilt Walker's and Dagger Thrower's accounts and pass their practicals. To trace the missing understudy, read the abandoned stage record, loft account, quarters letter and carousel tally, then hear the Retired Understudy. Report the facts here.
hemomancy.circus.school.exercise.veinwin: Practical: Pursue from the air, hit a rehearsal threat, then recall. Use your own known body and Crossbar; remain near the professor.
hemomancy.circus.school.ledger.veinwing_: Receive personal instruction from the Acrobat.
Prepare the offering and complete this shape's Cardinal Ordeal. Your Crossbar remains the reusable medium.
Return to the Acrobat and pursue from the air, hit a rehearsal threat, then recall.
Practical passed. This professor can host a daily paid guest act.
hemomancy.circus.school.exercise.marrow_: Practical: Land all three daggers of one volley on one rehearsal threat. Use your own known body and Crossbar; remain near the professor.
hemomancy.circus.school.ledger.marrow_sp: Receive personal instruction from the Dagger Thrower.
Prepare the offering and complete this shape's Cardinal Ordeal. Your Crossbar remains the reusable medium.
Return to the Dagger Thrower and land all three daggers of one volley on one rehearsal threat.
Practical passed. This professor can host a daily paid guest act.

hemomancy.summon.cinder_bellows.lore: A coiled lower body supports a gaunt rib frame and exposed bellows lung. Its readable inhale becomes a short cone of fire, then a long recovery. The Fire Breather teaches restraint.

hemomancy.rite.guide.inscription: The circle is fed. Trace its sigils, then seal it at the Focus.
hemomancy.rite.guide.station_projection: Feed the station's circuits through the Focus.
hemomancy.rite.guide.subject_feeding: Project blood into the structure beside the Focus. The Working floor climbs it as it fills.
hemomancy.rite.guide.offering_procession: The floor draws your offerings in.
hemomancy.rite.guide.ring_woke.2: The second ring wakes. Feed its sores.

hemomancy.rite.ancestral_communion.name: Rite of Ancestral Communion
hemomancy.rite.ancestral_communion.desc: The ultimate rite of revelation. The caster opens a channel to the ancient fungal consciousness, receiving cryptic lore and hidden truths about the origins of hemomancy itself.
hemomancy.rite.apotheos_rite.name: Rite of Apotheos
hemomancy.rite.apotheos_rite.desc: The Eighth Degree rite. The practitioner crosses beyond Archon after completing Qliphoth Communion, accepting the final hush behind the Order's mask.
hemomancy.rite.archon_rite.desc: The seventh rite of the Hematic Order, crowning the practitioner as Archon and preparing the way for the hidden Eighth Degree.
hemomancy.rite.armature_consecration.des: Consecrate the Hematic Armature with the Armature Consecration Kit and close its two blood circuits.
hemomancy.rite.ashen_vessel_rite.desc: Through fire and ash the vessel is reborn blackened, hardened, and hungry. The ashen gourd drinks deeper than any before it.
hemomancy.rite.bloodline_founding.name: Rite of Bloodline Founding
hemomancy.rite.bloodline_founding.desc: A lesser rite that binds the caster's essence into a new bloodline, producing a presigned ancestral ledger that others may use to join.
hemomancy.rite.bloodline_recall.name: Rite of Bloodline Recall
hemomancy.rite.bloodline_recall.desc: A penitent rite that reconjures a lost ancestral ledger from the caster's blood memory. The covenant does not forget but neither does it forgive carelessness lightly.
hemomancy.rite.chamber_of_will.name: Rite of the Chamber of Will
hemomancy.rite.chamber_of_will.desc: A grand inward rite for the Sanctified. The caster folds blood-memory around a stable point of will, entering the private chamber that grows with their scars, infection, and ascension.
hemomancy.rite.clarity_ascension.name: Rite of Clarity Ascension
hemomancy.rite.clarity_ascension.desc: The Purified supplicant steps beyond mere cleansing into true sight. Surrounded by silver and crystal, the mind opens to clarity — the second phase of the Unstained path, where enlightenment begins.
hemomancy.rite.cortical_weave.name: Rite of the Cortical Weave
hemomancy.rite.cortical_weave.desc: Crown the Somatic Loom with a fold of cortex so it can see a Perfectus memory whole.
hemomancy.rite.covenant_vigil.name: Rite of the Covenant Vigil
hemomancy.rite.covenant_vigil.desc: A bloodline vigil in which one sworn helper shares the boundary and survives a full Grand ordeal beside the caster. Every assigned survivor gains ten minutes of resistance and regeneration.
hemomancy.rite.crimson_beacon.name: Rite of the Crimson Beacon
hemomancy.rite.crimson_beacon.desc: A binding rite that anchors the caster's dying essence to this location. Upon taking a fatal blow, the caster's body will be returned here before death claims them.
hemomancy.rite.crimson_vessel_rite.desc: The pallid vessel is steeped in the deepest scarlet, its walls drinking in the vitality of the blood arts until they flush crimson with purpose.
hemomancy.rite.eightfold_script.name: Rite of the Eightfold Script
hemomancy.rite.eightfold_script.desc: Rule the Scriptorium's lines in red so one inscription may be singled out from the rest.
hemomancy.rite.enduring_pattern.name: Rite of the Enduring Pattern
hemomancy.rite.enduring_pattern.desc: Bind the Resonant Forge's reader, hammer, and wax stabilizer into one lasting cadence.
hemomancy.rite.eternal_covenant.name: Rite of the Eternal Covenant
hemomancy.rite.eternal_covenant.desc: A transcendent rite that permanently expands the caster's maximum blood volume. This rite may only be performed once the covenant does not grant its boon twice.
hemomancy.rite.exsanguination.name: Rite of Exsanguination
hemomancy.rite.exsanguination.desc: A sacrifice rite. A named creature held inside the circle bleeds into the anchors; once it has given 200 mL the daemon can be sealed, and its lifeblood crystallizes into Sanguine Quintessence.
hemomancy.rite.first_condensation.name: Rite of the First Condensation
hemomancy.rite.first_condensation.desc: Seat a Ghastly Alembic behind the Focus and close its two blood circuits.
hemomancy.rite.founding_fane.name: Rite of the Founding Fane
hemomancy.rite.ganglionic_weave.name: Rite of the Ganglionic Weave
hemomancy.rite.ganglionic_weave.desc: Bind a harness of nerve into the Somatic Loom so it can feel its own threads and hold a Magister's memory.
hemomancy.rite.hematic_fortification.des: Permanently reduces vascular and manipulation strain by 15%.
hemomancy.rite.hematic_succession.name: Rite of Hematic Succession
hemomancy.rite.hematic_succession.desc: Place the effigy beside the Focus on a Venous Stone plinth. Seat Sanguine Quintessence in the Focus. In braziers anywhere above the floor, read clockwise round the Focus from its left, nearest and lowest first, offer the donated professional vial, your own identity-bearing vial, then Mnemonic Ambergris. A free compatible workplace is required inside your fane. The body forms over sixty seconds.
hemomancy.rite.hematic_unbinding.name: Rite of Hematic Unbinding
hemomancy.rite.hematic_unbinding.desc: A severance rite that dissolves the caster's bloodline, freeing all members and returning any shared blood deposits. The covenant is broken what was bound by blood is unbound.
The final vessel transcends flesh and gourd alike. Shaped from gilded venous stone and ancient blood, the curved horn is the apex of sanguine containment a relic that drinks the very essence of its bearer.
hemomancy.rite.hungering_earth.name: Rite of the Hungering Earth
hemomancy.rite.hungering_earth.desc: A corruption rite that feeds the caster's blood into the earth, converting the surrounding terrain into blood-touched stone and befouling ash.
hemomancy.rite.initiate_rite.desc: The third rite of the Hematic Order, granting formal entry into the Incarnadine Fane.
hemomancy.rite.lethe_covenant.name: Rite of the Lethe Covenant
hemomancy.rite.lethe_covenant.desc: The most powerful Unstained rite a grand consecration that claims the surrounding land for Lethe's dominion. Within 5 chunks for 30 minutes: mob spawns are halved, Silver Ward fully shields against all blood-magic bleeding, and Unstained practitioners passively gain purity each minute. A direct counter to the Rite of Sanguine Dominion.
hemomancy.rite.lethean_baptism.name: Rite of Lethean Baptism
hemomancy.rite.lethean_baptism.desc: The first rite of the Unstained path. The supplicant kneels before cleansed stone and lethean flowers, renouncing the blood and beginning the long walk toward purification.
hemomancy.rite.lethean_font.name: Rite of the Lethean Font
hemomancy.rite.lethean_font.desc: The pinnacle of the Unstained path. The Enlightened supplicant opens the primordial source of Lethe's purifying waters. All clarity-bearing souls within 50 blocks receive a surge of clarity and an hour-long blessing of silver and verdigris. A domain of ultimate stillness spreads 8 chunks in every direction for one hour the full inverse of Sanguine Dominion.
hemomancy.rite.lethean_judgment.name: Rite of Lethean Judgment
hemomancy.rite.lethean_judgment.desc: The most powerful rite of the Unstained — a holy cleansing that projects Lethe's will outward. All blood-active practitioners within range feel their veins seize and their manipulations scatter. A declaration of war against hemomancy itself.
hemomancy.rite.lethean_tide.name: Rite of the Lethean Tide
hemomancy.rite.mnemonic_restoration.name: Rite of Mnemonic Restoration
hemomancy.rite.mnemonic_restoration.desc: Place the effigy beside the Focus on a Venous Stone plinth. Seat Sanguine Quintessence in the Focus. In braziers anywhere above the floor, read clockwise round the Focus from its left, nearest and lowest first, offer a Bound Mnemonic Remnant, then your own identity-bearing blood vial. A free compatible workplace is required inside your fane. The body forms over sixty seconds.
hemomancy.rite.monolithic_armature.name: Rite of the Monolithic Armature
hemomancy.rite.monolithic_armature.desc: Set the Monolithic Cornerstone into a consecrated Armature and bind three blood circuits.
hemomancy.rite.pale_consecration.name: Rite of Pale Consecration
hemomancy.rite.pale_consecration.desc: The supplicant lays down a grid of cleansed stone, pale silver, and suspended crystals, calling down Lethe's judgment upon the ground itself. For 10 minutes, hostile creatures that enter the consecrated area are seared and slowed a ward against the blood-touched.
hemomancy.rite.pale_vigil.name: Rite of the Pale Vigil
hemomancy.rite.pale_vigil.desc: Performed by those who have crossed halfway into clarity, the Pale Vigil calls upon Our Lady's watchful gaze. All Unstained souls within 40 blocks draw clarity from the light, their Silver Ward and Verdigris Aura strengthened for thirty minutes.
hemomancy.rite.palimpsest.name: Rite of the Palimpsest
hemomancy.rite.palimpsest.desc: Scrape the Scriptorium's vellum back to memory and cut the chosen inscription deeper than ink can hold.
hemomancy.rite.pallid_shadow.name: Rite of the Pallid Shadow
hemomancy.rite.pallid_shadow.desc: A blasphemous rite that corrupts the still waters, stripping the Unstained purification from a nearby player. A direct assault on those who walk the path of Our Lady and an unforgivable act of hematic aggression.
hemomancy.rite.pallid_vessel_rite.desc: The dried gourd is consecrated within a ring of venous stone and ash, its hollow interior awakening to hold the lifeblood of its creator.
hemomancy.rite.puppeteer_trial_cinder_be: Weather the breathing cycle and bind its shape to an attuned Crossbar.
hemomancy.rite.puppeteer_trial_gorebound: Bind the defeated Gorebound Hulk shape to an attuned Marionette Crossbar.
hemomancy.rite.puppeteer_trial_marrow_sp: Bind the defeated Marrow Spitter shape to an attuned Marionette Crossbar.
hemomancy.rite.puppeteer_trial_mnemonist: Bind the defeated Mnemonist Puppet shape to an attuned Marionette Crossbar.
hemomancy.rite.puppeteer_trial_sanguine_: Survive the hound's rupture and bind its pursuit shape to an attuned Marionette Crossbar.
hemomancy.rite.puppeteer_trial_scarlet_m: Hold the Scarlet Mummer's attention and bind the defeated shape to an attuned Marionette Crossbar.
hemomancy.rite.puppeteer_trial_veinwing_: Bind the defeated Veinwing Vulture shape to an attuned Marionette Crossbar.
hemomancy.rite.rooted_vein.name: Rite of the Rooted Vein
hemomancy.rite.rooted_vein.desc: A blood-fed stone is rooted into the earth, growing a permanent Earthen Vein where the Cardinal Focus stood.
hemomancy.rite.sanctified_rite.desc: The sixth rite of the Hematic Order, consecrating the practitioner fully to the Bloodline Covenant.
hemomancy.rite.sanguine_athanor.name: Rite of the Sanguine Athanor
hemomancy.rite.sanguine_athanor.desc: Raise a vented heating mantle beneath a Hematic Condenser, leaving room for its wider base and raised assembly.
hemomancy.rite.sanguine_attunement.name: Rite of Sanguine Attunement
hemomancy.rite.sanguine_attunement.desc: A cleansing rite that purges and resets the caster's blood tendency alignments, allowing them to realign their kinship from a blank slate.
hemomancy.rite.sanguine_brotherhood.name: Rite of the Sanguine Brotherhood
hemomancy.rite.sanguine_brotherhood.desc: The fourth rite of the Hematic Order, proving mastery of the foundational blood arts.
hemomancy.rite.sanguine_dominion.name: Rite of Sanguine Dominion
hemomancy.rite.sanguine_dominion.desc: An imperial rite that claims the surrounding land as a Blood Domain. Within its bounds, the caster's manipulations cost less blood, enemies suffer a slow bleeding curse, and blood-touched blocks are empowered.
hemomancy.rite.sanguine_eclipse.name: Rite of the Sanguine Eclipse
hemomancy.rite.sanguine_fervor.name: Rite of Sanguine Fervor
hemomancy.rite.sanguine_fervor.desc: A hunting rite that saturates the earth with vital blood-heat, drawing creatures from the dark. For a short time, mobs spawn at greatly increased rates within a 3-chunk radius, making the area ideal for farming.
hemomancy.rite.scarlet_summons.name: Rite of the Scarlet Summons
hemomancy.rite.scarlet_summons.desc: A commanding rite that draws upon the shared bloodline pool to teleport all online bloodline members to the rite location. The cost scales with the number of members summoned.
hemomancy.rite.second_fraction.name: Rite of the Second Fraction
hemomancy.rite.second_fraction.desc: Seat a calibrated Vial Centrifuge behind the Focus and close three circuits for a second fraction.
hemomancy.rite.severed_covenant.name: Rite of the Severed Covenant
hemomancy.rite.severed_covenant.desc: An exceptional founder's renunciation learned from the collapse of an unleashed infection. It disbands the founder's bloodline and cuts its integration from their infection.
hemomancy.rite.silthmeres_remembrance.de: A rite invoking Silthmere, the name-like liturgical title of Our Lady of Still Waters. All Unstained souls within 32 blocks are blessed at once each gains 5 purity and has their Verdigris Aura refreshed. A single moment of grace, freely given.
hemomancy.rite.silver_dawn.name: Rite of the Silver Dawn
hemomancy.rite.silver_dawn.desc: A grand consecration that radiates silver-green light, cleansing blood-stained blocks in a wide radius and strengthening the caster's Verdigris Aura. Requires Clarity.
hemomancy.rite.silver_veil.name: Rite of the Silver Veil
hemomancy.rite.silver_veil.desc: A consecration rite that draws silver light from the cleansed blocks, weaving a protective veil around the supplicant. The Silver Ward shields the faithful from the touch of blood magic.
hemomancy.rite.steady_separation.name: Rite of the Steady Separation
hemomancy.rite.steady_separation.desc: Seat a base Vial Centrifuge behind the Focus and steady its two recovery circuits.
hemomancy.rite.still_waters.name: Rite of Still Waters
hemomancy.rite.still_waters.desc: A calming rite performed at a junction of cleansed stone and pale silver. The still light of the lanterns suppresses all blood-magic violence in the area magic damage dealt within the zone is reduced by 30% for 5 minutes.
hemomancy.rite.true_groove.name: Rite of the True Groove
hemomancy.rite.true_groove.desc: Seat a Resonant Forge behind the Focus and align its wheel and carving stylus.
hemomancy.rite.vascular_mending.name: Rite of Vascular Mending
hemomancy.rite.vascular_mending.desc: A restorative rite that floods the caster's vascular system with purified blood, fully healing all five vein sections from strain and damage.
message.hemomancy.saint_sarcophagus.the_: The paste blackens on the stone. The Saint remembers insult before mercy.
message.hemomancy.saint_sarcophagus.you_: You lack sufficient blood to offer.
message.hemomancy.saint_sarcophagus.the_: The bowl drinks deep. A heavy click echoes from within the stone.
The lid refuses to budge without proper reverence.
message.hemomancy.saint_sarcophagus.you_: You heave the lid back into place.
You slide the lid off to the side with a loud thud and marvel the corpse infront of you.
message.hemomancy.saint_sarcophagus.the_: The corpus is still... recovering. Wait.
The corpus has already yielded what it will give peacefully.
The corpus recoils from your blood. The Saint wakes in rejection.
The corpus yields its blood. Process the Consecrated Syringe in a Vial Centrifuge.
message.hemomancy.hemorath.hemorath_s_ho: Hemorath's hollow frame strains with stolen blood.
message.hemomancy.hemorath.the_hollow_ve: The Hollow Vessel stirs. Blood will be spent.
message.hemomancy.hemorath.hemorath_burs: Hemorath bursts, exsanguinated by the blood he refused to release.
message.hemomancy.hemorath.the_vessel_qu: The Vessel quiets. You carry the enzyme of Saint Hemorath.
message.hemomancy.putriciel.the_rot_stil: The rot stills — absolve him now!
message.hemomancy.seraphae.seraphae_the_: Seraphae, the Chain Saint, stirs. Maintain containment.
Seraphae, the Chain Saint, fractures! Bind the fragments!
message.hemomancy.seraphae.the_chains_dr: The chains draw Seraphae inward - strike now for containment!
message.hemomancy.seraphae.seraphae_is_c: Seraphae is chained once more. The radiance is contained.

tooltip.hemomancy.qliphoth_pome.one_of_n: One of nine. Sweet in the way that TV static and silence are sweet.

tooltip.hemomancy.hemolytic_vial.harbing: Harbingers and blood-kin will find little mercy in it.

tooltip.hemomancy.lethean_chalice.a_chal: A chalice for still water, meant to rinse away what the blood remembers.

tooltip.hemomancy.pale_silver_bell.a_han: A handbell of pale silver, tuned to make blood-magic hesitate.
tooltip.hemomancy.pale_silver_bell.use_s: Use: Silver Ward and a weakening chime against nearby hostiles.
tooltip.hemomancy.pallid_infusion.ghost_: Ghost Pipe and white humor, coldly distilled.
tooltip.hemomancy.absolution_dagger.coat: Coated in a hyper coagulant that seems to halt any blood from being spilled.
